examples.en: They took out a mortgage to buy their first home.
examples.zh: 他們辦了房屋貸款來買第一間房子。

examples.en: The bank approved our mortgage last week.
examples.zh: 銀行上週核准了我們的房貸。

examples.en: Paying off the mortgage early saved them a lot of interest.
examples.zh: 提早還清房貸讓他們省下不少利息。

examples.en: There was a nasty smell coming from the kitchen.
examples.zh: 廚房傳來一股難聞的味道。

examples.en: The weather was nasty, so we stayed home all weekend.
examples.zh: 天氣很糟，所以我們整個週末都待在家裡。

examples.en: He left a nasty comment on her post.
examples.zh: 他在她的貼文底下留了一則惡劣的留言。

examples.en: The negotiation between the two companies lasted three days.
examples.zh: 兩家公司之間的談判持續了三天。

examples.en: Salary is often a matter for negotiation.
examples.zh: 薪資通常是可以協商的。

examples.en: After long negotiations, the union and the factory reached an agreement.
examples.zh: 經過長時間的協商，工會與工廠達成了協議。

examples.en: There is nowhere to park near the school.
examples.zh: 學校附近沒有地方可以停車。

examples.en: I have nowhere to go this weekend.
examples.zh: 這個週末我無處可去。

examples.en: The lost cat was nowhere to be found.
examples.zh: 那隻走失的貓到處都找不到。

examples.en: Vegetables are rich in important nutrients.
examples.zh: 蔬菜富含重要的營養素。

examples.en: Plants take nutrients from the soil through their roots.
examples.zh: 植物透過根部從土壤中吸收養分。

examples.en: Milk provides many of the nutrients that children need.
examples.zh: 牛奶提供孩子所需的許多營養素。

examples.en: Good nutrition is important for growing children.
examples.zh: 良好的營養對成長中的孩子很重要。

examples.en: Our school offers a class on nutrition for all students.
examples.zh: 我們學校為所有學生開設了營養課。

examples.en: She studied nutrition at university and became a dietitian.
examples.zh: 她在大學主修營養學，後來成為營養師。

examples.en: Our team will face a strong opponent in the final.
examples.zh: 我們的隊伍在決賽中將面對一個強勁的對手。

examples.en: The mayor's opponents say the new road is too expensive.
examples.zh: 市長的反對者表示這條新路太花錢。

examples.en: He shook hands with his opponent after the match.
examples.zh: 比賽結束後，他與對手握了手。

examples.en: There was strong opposition to the new parking fee.
examples.zh: 新的停車費遭到強烈反對。

examples.en: The opposition in parliament asked the government many questions.
examples.zh: 國會中的反對黨向政府提出許多質問。

examples.en: Despite the opposition from her parents, she moved to Taipei.
examples.zh: 儘管父母反對，她還是搬到了台北。

examples.en: The factory has doubled its output this year.
examples.zh: 這家工廠今年的產量增加了一倍。

examples.en: The printer is the output device for this computer.
examples.zh: 印表機是這台電腦的輸出裝置。

examples.en: Her output of articles each week is impressive.
examples.zh: 她每週的文章產出量令人佩服。

examples.en: The overall cost of the trip was lower than we expected.
examples.zh: 這趟旅行的整體花費比我們預期的低。

examples.en: Our overall score was higher than last year's.
examples.zh: 我們的總成績比去年高。

examples.en: The teacher gave an overall review of the semester.
examples.zh: 老師對整個學期做了全面的複習。

examples.en: Overall, the meeting went very well despite a few technical problems.
examples.zh: 整體而言，雖然出現了一些技術問題，會議仍進行得很順利。

examples.en: The hotel was a bit noisy, but overall we enjoyed our stay.
examples.zh: 這間旅館有點吵，但整體來說我們住得很愉快。

examples.en: Overall, prices rose by two percent last month.
examples.zh: 整體而言，上個月物價上漲了百分之二。

examples.en: A plane flew overhead as we sat in the yard.
examples.zh: 我們坐在院子裡時，一架飛機從頭頂飛過。

examples.en: Dark clouds gathered overhead before the rain.
examples.zh: 下雨前，頭頂上聚集了烏雲。

examples.en: Birds were singing in the trees overhead.
examples.zh: 頭頂上方的樹上有鳥在唱歌。

examples.en: Please put your bag in the overhead compartment.
examples.zh: 請把你的包包放進頭頂上方的行李櫃。

examples.en: The overhead light in the classroom is broken.
examples.zh: 教室裡的頂燈壞了。

examples.en: An overhead bridge connects the station to the mall.
examples.zh: 一座天橋把車站和購物中心連接起來。

examples.en: The bus tried to overtake a slow truck on the highway.
examples.zh: 公車想在高速公路上超過一輛慢速的卡車。

examples.en: Online sales may soon overtake sales at physical stores.
examples.zh: 網路銷售額可能很快就會超越實體店面的銷售額。

examples.en: She worked hard to overtake her classmates in math.
examples.zh: 她努力在數學上超越同學。

examples.en: Draw two parallel lines on the paper.
examples.zh: 在紙上畫兩條平行線。

examples.en: The road runs parallel to the river.
examples.zh: 這條路與河流平行。

examples.en: The two stories have many parallel details.
examples.zh: 這兩個故事有許多相似的細節。

examples.en: There are many parallels between the two writers.
examples.zh: 這兩位作家有許多相似之處。

examples.en: Students drew a parallel between the book and the movie.
examples.zh: 學生們指出這本書和那部電影的相似之處。

examples.en: The map shows the parallels of latitude.
examples.zh: 這張地圖標示出緯線。

examples.en: Each participant received a free T-shirt after completing the charity run.
examples.zh: 每位參與者完成公益路跑後，都拿到一件免費的T恤。

examples.en: The participants in the study were all high school students.
examples.zh: 這項研究的參與者都是高中生。

examples.en: Every participant must sign in at the front desk.
examples.zh: 每位參加者都必須在櫃檯簽到。

senses.zh: 農民（尤指貧苦或傳統農業社會中的農民）

examples.en: In the past, most peasants lived in small villages.
examples.zh: 過去大多數農民都住在小村莊裡。

examples.en: The peasant sold rice at the local market.
examples.zh: 那位農民在當地市場賣米。

examples.en: Peasants paid a large part of their harvest as taxes.
examples.zh: 農民把很大一部分的收成當作稅繳出去。

examples.en: He pressed the brake pedal to stop the car.
examples.zh: 他踩下煞車踏板讓車子停下來。

examples.en: The left pedal on my bike is broken.
examples.zh: 我腳踏車的左踏板壞了。

examples.en: The piano has a pedal that makes the sound last longer.
examples.zh: 這架鋼琴有個踏板可以讓聲音持續得更久。

examples.en: We pedaled along the river on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我們週日沿著河邊騎車。

examples.en: She pedaled hard up the steep hill.
examples.zh: 她用力踩著踏板爬上陡坡。

examples.en: The boy pedaled home along the quiet street before dinner.
examples.zh: 男孩在晚餐前沿著安靜的街道騎車回家。

examples.en: The street performer drew a big crowd.
examples.zh: 那位街頭藝人吸引了一大群人。

examples.en: Every performer practiced for weeks before the show.
examples.zh: 每位表演者在演出前都練習了好幾個星期。

examples.en: She is a talented performer and also a good teacher.
examples.zh: 她是個有才華的表演者，同時也是位好老師。

examples.en: If the pain persists, you should see a doctor.
examples.zh: 如果疼痛持續不退，你應該去看醫生。

examples.en: She persisted in practicing the violin every evening.
examples.zh: 她堅持每天晚上練小提琴。

examples.en: The rain persisted through the whole weekend.
examples.zh: 這場雨整個週末都沒停。

senses.zh: 攝影的；如照片般精確的（用於記憶力）

examples.en: The museum has a large photographic collection.
examples.zh: 這間博物館有大量的攝影收藏。

examples.en: She has a photographic memory and never forgets a face.
examples.zh: 她擁有過目不忘的記憶力，從來不會忘記一張臉。

examples.en: He bought some photographic equipment for the trip.
examples.zh: 他為這趟旅行買了一些攝影器材。

examples.en: The children dressed up as pirates for the party.
examples.zh: 孩子們為了派對打扮成海盜。

examples.en: The movie is about a pirate who looks for hidden treasure.
examples.zh: 這部電影在講一個尋找隱藏寶藏的海盜。

examples.en: The company took legal action against pirates who sold unauthorized copies of its software.
examples.zh: 這家公司對販售未經授權軟體複本的盜版者採取法律行動。

examples.en: In English, the plural of the noun child is children.
examples.zh: 在英文中，名詞「child」的複數是「children」。

examples.en: Is this word in the singular or the plural?
examples.zh: 這個字是單數還是複數？

examples.en: Our teacher asked us to write the plural of each noun.
examples.zh: 老師要我們寫出每個名詞的複數形。

examples.en: The teacher explained that "books" is a plural form of "book".
examples.zh: 老師解釋，「books」是「book」的複數形。

examples.en: Use a plural verb after the word "they."
examples.zh: 在「they」後面要用複數動詞。

examples.en: Some plural forms are irregular, so students need to learn them separately.
examples.zh: 有些複數形不規則，因此學生需要另外學習這些字形。

examples.en: The presidential election will be held next January.
examples.zh: 總統大選將在明年一月舉行。

examples.en: The presidential office is in the center of Taipei.
examples.zh: 總統府位於台北市中心。

examples.en: She watched the presidential speech on television.
examples.zh: 她在電視上收看了總統的演說。

senses.zh: 進步的；漸進的；進步主義的

examples.en: The school has a progressive approach to learning.
examples.zh: 這所學校採取進步的學習方式。

examples.en: There has been a progressive improvement in his grades.
examples.zh: 他的成績逐步進步。

examples.en: Many young people support progressive ideas about the environment.
examples.zh: 許多年輕人支持有關環境的進步理念。

examples.en: The school rules prohibit students from using phones in class.
examples.zh: 學校規定禁止學生在課堂上使用手機。

examples.en: Smoking is prohibited in this building.
examples.zh: 這棟大樓內禁止吸菸。

examples.en: The law prohibits drivers from texting on the road.
examples.zh: 法律禁止駕駛人在路上傳簡訊。

examples.en: A large proportion of the students walk to school.
examples.zh: 很大比例的學生走路上學。

examples.en: The proportion of boys to girls in our class is one to one.
examples.zh: 我們班男生與女生的比例是一比一。

examples.en: The bedroom is small in proportion to the rest of the house.
examples.zh: 相較於房子的其他部分，這間臥室很小。

senses.zh: 前景；可能性；將來可能發生的事

examples.en: The job offers good prospects for young engineers.
examples.zh: 這份工作對年輕工程師來說前景看好。

examples.en: There is little prospect of rain this week.
examples.zh: 這週不太可能下雨。

examples.en: She was excited at the prospect of traveling abroad.
examples.zh: 一想到要出國旅行，她就很興奮。

examples.en: Canada has ten provinces and three territories.
examples.zh: 加拿大有十個省和三個地區。

examples.en: Fujian is a province in southeastern China.
examples.zh: 福建是中國東南方的一個省份。

examples.en: Each province has its own local government.
examples.zh: 每個省都有自己的地方政府。

examples.en: You need to pass a test to qualify for the scholarship.
examples.zh: 你必須通過測驗才有資格領取獎學金。

examples.en: The author qualified her statement by adding an important exception.
examples.zh: 作者補上一項重要的例外，對自己的陳述加以限定。

examples.en: Two years of training will qualify her to teach swimming.
examples.zh: 兩年的訓練會讓她具備教游泳的資格。

examples.en: Too much radiation can harm the human body.
examples.zh: 過多的輻射會傷害人體。

examples.en: The doctor explained that an X-ray uses a small amount of radiation.
examples.zh: 醫生解釋X光只用了少量的輻射。

examples.en: Scientists measure the radiation from the sun.
examples.zh: 科學家測量來自太陽的輻射。

examples.en: The company made a radical change to its schedule.
examples.zh: 公司對時程做了徹底的改變。

examples.en: His radical ideas surprised the teachers.
examples.zh: 他激進的想法讓老師們很驚訝。

examples.en: The new law brought radical reform to the school system.
examples.zh: 這項新法為學校制度帶來根本性的改革。

examples.en: The old man was a radical in his youth.
examples.zh: 那位老先生年輕時是個激進分子。

examples.en: In math class, we learned how to simplify radicals such as the square root of twenty.
examples.zh: 數學課上，我們學習化簡根式，例如二十的平方根。

examples.en: Some radicals wanted to change the whole system.
examples.zh: 一些激進分子想要改變整個制度。

examples.en: The kids sat at the rear of the bus.
examples.zh: 孩子們坐在公車的後部。

examples.en: There is a small garden at the rear of the house.
examples.zh: 房子後面有一座小花園。

examples.en: Please move to the rear of the line.
examples.zh: 請移到隊伍的後面。

examples.en: Please use the rear door to get off the bus.
examples.zh: 請從後門下車。

examples.en: The car has a rear window that opens.
examples.zh: 這輛車的後車窗可以打開。

examples.en: He checked the rear tire before the ride.
examples.zh: 他在騎乘前檢查了後輪胎。

senses.zh: 養育；飼養；用後腿站立（指動物）

examples.en: They reared three children in a small town.
examples.zh: 他們在一個小鎮養大了三個孩子。

examples.en: Farmers in this area rear cattle and sheep.
examples.zh: 這個地區的農民飼養牛和羊。

examples.en: The horse reared up on its hind legs at the sudden noise.
examples.zh: 那匹馬聽到突如其來的聲響，抬起前腿，用後腿站立。

examples.en: The country entered a recession last year.
examples.zh: 這個國家去年陷入經濟衰退。

examples.en: Many small shops closed during the recession.
examples.zh: 許多小店在不景氣期間倒閉。

examples.en: Experts say the recession will end soon.
examples.zh: 專家說經濟衰退很快就會結束。

examples.en: Each student had to recite a poem in class.
examples.zh: 每位學生都得在課堂上朗誦一首詩。

examples.en: He can recite the whole alphabet backward.
examples.zh: 他能把整個字母表倒背出來。

examples.en: The children recited the school rules together.
examples.zh: 孩子們一起背誦校規。

examples.en: Can you recommend a good restaurant near here?
examples.zh: 你能推薦這附近的一間好餐廳嗎？

examples.en: The doctor recommends drinking more water after exercise in hot weather.
examples.zh: 醫師建議在炎熱天氣運動後多喝水。

examples.en: My teacher recommended this book to me.
examples.zh: 我的老師向我推薦了這本書。

examples.en: The weather was bad, but they went hiking regardless.
examples.zh: 天氣很差，但他們還是照樣去健行。

examples.en: Everyone told her to rest, but she kept working regardless.
examples.zh: 大家都叫她休息，她還是繼續工作。

examples.en: The museum welcomes all visitors regardless of their age or nationality.
examples.zh: 這間博物館歡迎所有訪客，不分年齡或國籍。

examples.en: The school play has a rehearsal every Friday.
examples.zh: 學校的話劇每週五都有排練。

examples.en: We had a dress rehearsal the night before the concert.
examples.zh: 音樂會前一晚，我們進行了彩排。

examples.en: Don't be late for tomorrow's rehearsal; the director needs everyone on stage.
examples.zh: 明天的排練別遲到；導演需要所有人都到舞台上。

examples.en: I set a reminder on my phone for the meeting.
examples.zh: 我在手機上設了開會的提醒。

examples.en: This is a friendly reminder that the library books are due on Monday.
examples.zh: 在此提醒您，圖書館的書週一到期。

examples.en: The photo is a reminder of our trip to Japan.
examples.zh: 這張照片讓人想起我們的日本之旅。

senses.zh: 共和政體的；共和黨的（大寫時）

examples.en: France is a republican country with a president.
examples.zh: 法國是有總統的共和國。

examples.en: The republican form of government has no king.
examples.zh: 共和政體沒有國王。

examples.en: The newspaper interviewed a Republican candidate about local transport plans.
examples.zh: 這家報社訪問了一位共和黨候選人，討論當地交通計畫。

examples.en: He is a republican who opposes the monarchy.
examples.zh: 他是反對君主制的共和主義者。

examples.en: My uncle in the United States is a Republican.
examples.zh: 我在美國的叔叔是共和黨員。

examples.en: The republicans held a meeting in the city hall.
examples.zh: 共和主義者在市政廳舉行了一場會議。

examples.en: The mayor's official residence is near the park.
examples.zh: 市長的官邸在公園附近。

examples.en: Please write your place of residence on the form.
examples.zh: 請在表格上填寫你的居住地。

examples.en: Their residence in Taipei lasted ten years.
examples.zh: 他們在台北住了十年。

examples.en: Residents of this building share a small garden.
examples.zh: 這棟大樓的住戶共用一座小花園。

examples.en: The city asked residents to save water.
examples.zh: 市政府呼籲居民節約用水。

examples.en: The resident examined the patient before discussing the case with a senior doctor.
examples.zh: 那位住院醫師檢查病人後，與資深醫師討論病情。

examples.en: It is ridiculous to expect one person to finish all this work overnight.
examples.zh: 期待一個人一夜之間完成所有這些工作，實在很荒謬。

examples.en: He looked ridiculous in that big hat.
examples.zh: 他戴著那頂大帽子看起來很可笑。

examples.en: The price of a cup of coffee was ridiculous.
examples.zh: 那杯咖啡的價格貴得離譜。

examples.en: The museum has an old rifle from the 1800s.
examples.zh: 博物館裡有一把十九世紀的老步槍。

examples.en: A collector showed us his antique rifle.
examples.zh: 一位收藏家向我們展示了他的古董步槍。

examples.en: The guard carried a rifle during the ceremony.
examples.zh: 儀式中，衛兵扛著一把步槍。

examples.en: The two schools have been rivals for years.
examples.zh: 這兩所學校多年來一直是競爭對手。

examples.en: Our team beat its biggest rival last night.
examples.zh: 我們的隊伍昨晚打敗了最大的對手。

examples.en: The bakery has no rival in this town.
examples.zh: 這間麵包店在鎮上沒有對手。

examples.en: The two rival companies fought for the same customers.
examples.zh: 這兩家競爭的公司爭取同一批客人。

examples.en: A rival team won the trophy last year.
examples.zh: 去年是一支對手隊伍贏得了獎盃。

examples.en: The rival groups finally agreed to meet.
examples.zh: 對立的兩個團體終於同意見面。

examples.en: He packed a fishing rod for the trip.
examples.zh: 他為這趟旅行帶了一支釣竿。

examples.en: The curtain hangs from a metal rod.
examples.zh: 窗簾掛在一根金屬桿上。

examples.en: A lightning rod protects the building from lightning.
examples.zh: 避雷針保護這棟建築免受雷擊。

examples.en: Please scan the QR code at the entrance.
examples.zh: 請在入口處掃描QR碼。

examples.en: She scanned the menu and ordered noodles.
examples.zh: 她瀏覽了菜單，點了麵。

examples.en: The nurse will scan your arm to check the bone.
examples.zh: 護理師會掃描你的手臂來檢查骨頭。

examples.en: The doctor ordered a scan of his knee.
examples.zh: 醫師指示他接受膝蓋掃描檢查。

examples.en: A quick scan of the page showed three mistakes.
examples.zh: 快速瀏覽這一頁就發現了三個錯誤。

examples.en: The airport uses a body scan for security.
examples.zh: 機場使用人體掃描進行安全檢查。

examples.en: The city has a new scheme to reduce traffic.
examples.zh: 市府有一項減少交通量的新方案。

examples.en: The police uncovered a scheme to sell fake tickets online.
examples.zh: 警方揭發了一項在網路上販售假票的詐騙計畫。

examples.en: The color scheme of the room is blue and white.
examples.zh: 這個房間的配色是藍色和白色。

examples.en: The technology sector is growing fast as demand for digital services increases.
examples.zh: 隨著數位服務需求增加，科技產業正快速成長。

examples.en: She works in the public sector as a city planner.
examples.zh: 她在公部門擔任都市規劃師。

examples.en: The tourism sector was hit hard by the storm.
examples.zh: 觀光產業受到這場暴風雨的重創。

examples.en: We watched the whole TV series in one week.
examples.zh: 我們一個星期就看完了整部電視影集。

examples.en: A series of meetings will be held next month.
examples.zh: 下個月將舉行一系列會議。

examples.en: The writer has published a new book series for kids.
examples.zh: 這位作家出版了一套新的兒童系列書籍。

examples.en: The training session starts at nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 培訓課程九點開始。

examples.en: The class has a practice session after school.
examples.zh: 這個班級放學後有一堂練習課。

examples.en: The committee held a long session on Friday.
examples.zh: 委員會週五舉行了一場很長的會議。

examples.en: There is a shortage of water in the area.
examples.zh: 這個地區缺水。

examples.en: The shop had a shortage of masks last winter.
examples.zh: 這家店去年冬天口罩短缺。

examples.en: A shortage of nurses is a problem in many hospitals.
examples.zh: 護理師短缺是許多醫院面臨的問題。

examples.en: He shrugged and said he had no idea.
examples.zh: 他聳了聳肩，說他不知道。

examples.en: She shrugged her shoulders when I asked about the test.
examples.zh: 我問起考試的事時，她聳了聳肩。

examples.en: Tom just shrugged and walked away from the argument.
examples.zh: 湯姆只是聳聳肩，就從爭論中走開了。

examples.en: Her only answer to my question about the delay was a shrug.
examples.zh: 我問起延誤的事，她唯一的回答就是聳肩。

examples.en: With a shrug, he picked up his bag and left.
examples.zh: 他聳了聳肩，拿起包包就離開了。

examples.en: I gave a shrug because I did not care which movie we saw.
examples.zh: 我聳了聳肩，因為我不在乎看哪部電影。

examples.en: A free shuttle takes guests from the airport to the hotel.
examples.zh: 免費接駁車會載旅客從機場到飯店。

examples.en: The shuttle runs every twenty minutes between the two campuses.
examples.zh: 這班往返車每二十分鐘行駛於兩個校區之間。

examples.en: The weaver passed the shuttle across the loom.
examples.zh: 織工把梭子穿過織布機。

examples.en: The school bus shuttles students between the dorm and the library.
examples.zh: 校車載送學生往返於宿舍與圖書館之間。

examples.en: She shuttles between Taipei and Taichung for work.
examples.zh: 她因工作來回穿梭於台北與台中之間。

examples.en: Parents often shuttle their kids to cram schools after class.
examples.zh: 家長常在放學後接送孩子去補習班。

examples.en: Slavery was abolished in many countries during the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 奴隸制度在十九世紀於許多國家被廢除。

examples.en: Our history teacher talked about the end of slavery.
examples.zh: 我們的歷史老師談到奴隸制度的終結。

examples.en: The museum has an exhibit on the history of slavery.
examples.zh: 這間博物館有一個關於奴隸制度歷史的展覽。

examples.en: Thick smog covered the city this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上濃濃的煙霧籠罩了這座城市。

examples.en: Cars are one of the main causes of smog.
examples.zh: 汽車是造成煙霧的主要原因之一。

examples.en: Doctors advise people to stay indoors when the smog is bad.
examples.zh: 醫生建議煙霧嚴重時待在室內。

examples.en: The cat sneaked into the kitchen while no one was looking.
examples.zh: 趁沒人注意，貓偷偷溜進了廚房。

examples.en: He tried to sneak out of the classroom before the bell rang.
examples.zh: 他想在鐘響前偷偷溜出教室。

examples.en: The children sneaked some candy into the movie theater.
examples.zh: 孩子們偷偷把一些糖果帶進電影院。

examples.en: The little girl sobbed when she lost her teddy bear.
examples.zh: 小女孩弄丟泰迪熊時啜泣了起來。

examples.en: He sobbed quietly at the back of the room.
examples.zh: 他在房間後方靜靜地啜泣。

examples.en: "I failed the exam," she sobbed as her friend tried to comfort her.
examples.zh: 「我考試不及格。」她啜泣著說，朋友則試著安慰她。

examples.en: We heard a soft sob from the next room.
examples.zh: 我們聽到隔壁房間傳來輕輕的啜泣聲。

examples.en: She answered with a sob and could not say more.
examples.zh: 她哭泣著回答，說不出更多話。

examples.en: Between sobs, the boy told us what had happened.
examples.zh: 男孩邊啜泣邊告訴我們發生了什麼事。

examples.en: I bought a small souvenir for my mother at the night market.
examples.zh: 我在夜市替媽媽買了一個小紀念品。

examples.en: This keychain is a souvenir from our trip to Japan.
examples.zh: 這個鑰匙圈是我們去日本旅行的紀念品。

examples.en: Most tourists buy a souvenir before they leave the island.
examples.zh: 大多數遊客在離開小島前都會買一份紀念品。

senses.zh: 播種；引起（多指負面感受）

examples.en: Farmers sow rice seeds in the spring.
examples.zh: 農夫在春天播下稻種。

examples.en: We sowed some flower seeds in the garden last weekend.
examples.zh: 上週末我們在花園裡播了一些花種。

examples.en: False rumors can sow doubt among people who trust each other.
examples.zh: 不實的傳言可能在原本互相信任的人之間種下懷疑。

examples.en: The lake sparkled in the morning sun.
examples.zh: 湖水在晨光中閃閃發亮。

examples.en: Her eyes sparkled when she saw the birthday cake.
examples.zh: 她看到生日蛋糕時，眼睛閃閃發亮。

examples.en: The new car sparkled after we washed it.
examples.zh: 我們洗過新車後，它閃閃發亮。

examples.en: There was a sparkle in her eyes as she told the story.
examples.zh: 她講故事時，眼中閃著光采。

examples.en: The sparkle of the diamond caught everyone's attention.
examples.zh: 鑽石的閃光吸引了所有人的目光。

examples.en: The dress has a little sparkle on the sleeves.
examples.zh: 這件洋裝的袖子上有一點閃亮的光澤。

examples.en: Thousands of spectators filled the stadium to watch the championship game.
examples.zh: 數千名觀眾擠滿體育場，觀看冠軍賽。

examples.en: The spectators cheered when our team scored.
examples.zh: 我們的隊伍得分時，觀眾歡聲雷動。

examples.en: The spectators watched the rescue from a safe distance after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故發生後，旁觀者從安全距離外觀看救援過程。

examples.en: I like spicy beef noodles on a cold day.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在寒冷的日子吃辣的牛肉麵。

examples.en: The soup was too spicy for the little boy.
examples.zh: 這碗湯對小男孩來說太辣了。

examples.en: Do you want your chicken mild or spicy?
examples.zh: 你要口味溫和的雞肉，還是辣味的？

examples.en: A local bank is the main sponsor of the marathon.
examples.zh: 一家本地銀行是這場馬拉松的主要贊助商。

examples.en: The sponsor paid for all the school's new uniforms.
examples.zh: 贊助者出資買下學校所有的新制服。

examples.en: We are looking for a sponsor for our class trip.
examples.zh: 我們正在為班遊尋找贊助者。

examples.en: Our company sponsors a basketball team in the city.
examples.zh: 我們公司贊助市內的一支籃球隊。

examples.en: The shop sponsored the school concert last year.
examples.zh: 這家店去年贊助了學校的音樂會。

examples.en: A famous brand will sponsor the film festival.
examples.zh: 一個知名品牌將贊助這場影展。

examples.en: Our jobs are at stake if the company loses this client.
examples.zh: 如果公司失去這位客戶，我們的工作就岌岌可危。

examples.en: She owns a small stake in her brother's restaurant.
examples.zh: 她持有自己兄弟那間餐廳的一小部分股份。

examples.en: The campers drove a wooden stake into the ground to hold the tent.
examples.zh: 露營的人把一根木樁打進地面來固定帳篷。

examples.en: My father steered the boat toward the dock.
examples.zh: 我爸爸把船駛向碼頭。

examples.en: It is hard to steer a bike with one hand.
examples.zh: 單手很難駕馭腳踏車。

examples.en: The teacher steered the discussion back to the main topic.
examples.zh: 老師把討論引導回主題。

examples.en: Music lessons can stimulate the brain by engaging memory and attention.
examples.zh: 音樂課能透過運用記憶力與注意力來刺激大腦。

examples.en: The government wants to stimulate the economy.
examples.zh: 政府想要刺激經濟。

examples.en: Colorful pictures stimulate children's interest in reading.
examples.zh: 色彩繽紛的圖片能激發孩子的閱讀興趣。

examples.en: The store has plenty of stock for the holiday season.
examples.zh: 這家店為假期備足了庫存。

examples.en: He bought some stock in a technology company.
examples.zh: 他買了一些科技公司的股票。

examples.en: The cook added vegetable stock to the soup for extra flavor.
examples.zh: 廚師在湯裡加入蔬菜高湯，以增添風味。

examples.en: The supermarket stocks fresh fruit from local farms.
examples.zh: 這間超市備有來自在地農場的新鮮水果可供販售。

examples.en: We stocked the kitchen with rice and canned food.
examples.zh: 我們在廚房裡備好了米和罐頭食品。

examples.en: The library is well stocked with English books.
examples.zh: 這間圖書館備有大量英文書籍。

senses.zh: 代替者；代用品；替補球員

examples.en: Honey is a good substitute for sugar in tea.
examples.zh: 蜂蜜是茶裡糖的好替代品。

examples.en: Our regular teacher is sick, so a substitute will teach today's class.
examples.zh: 平常教我們的老師生病了，所以今天由代課老師上課。

examples.en: The coach sent in a substitute in the second half.
examples.zh: 教練在下半場派了一名替補球員上場。

examples.en: You can substitute butter with olive oil in this recipe.
examples.zh: 這道食譜裡，你可以用橄欖油代替奶油。

examples.en: The manager substituted a tired player with a fresh one.
examples.zh: 總教練把一名疲累的球員換成體力充沛的球員。

examples.en: Please do not substitute any ingredients in the cake.
examples.zh: 請不要替換蛋糕裡的任何食材。

examples.en: The chef prepared a superb dinner for the guests.
examples.zh: 主廚為賓客準備了一頓極棒的晚餐。

examples.en: She did a superb job on the science project.
examples.zh: 她在自然科學專題上表現得非常出色。

examples.en: The hotel offers a superb view of the sea.
examples.zh: 這間飯店可以欣賞絕佳的海景。

senses.zh: 主管；指導老師（指研究或論文）

examples.en: My supervisor approved my leave request this morning.
examples.zh: 我的主管今天早上核准了我的請假申請。

examples.en: The new supervisor holds a team meeting every Monday.
examples.zh: 新主管每週一都會召開團隊會議。

examples.en: My thesis supervisor suggested several books to help me develop my research topic.
examples.zh: 我的論文指導老師推薦了幾本書，幫助我發展研究主題。

examples.en: The Supreme Court made its final decision yesterday.
examples.zh: 最高法院昨天做出了最終裁決。

examples.en: She won the match with supreme confidence.
examples.zh: 她以極度的自信贏得了比賽。

examples.en: Safety is of supreme importance on a construction site.
examples.zh: 在工地，安全是最重要的。

examples.en: The school suspended classes because of the typhoon.
examples.zh: 學校因颱風而停課。

examples.en: The company suspended the worker until the review was finished.
examples.zh: 在審查結束前，公司讓這名員工停職。

examples.en: A lamp was suspended from the ceiling by a thin chain.
examples.zh: 一盞燈由一條細鏈子從天花板垂吊下來。

senses.zh: 症狀；徵兆（比喻問題的表現）

examples.en: A fever is a common symptom of the flu.
examples.zh: 發燒是流感的常見症狀。

examples.en: If your symptoms get worse, please see a doctor.
examples.zh: 如果你的症狀惡化，請去看醫生。

examples.en: A high turnover of staff can be a symptom of poor management.
examples.zh: 員工離職率高，可能是管理不善的徵兆。

examples.en: Please check which terminal your flight departs from before heading to the airport.
examples.zh: 前往機場之前，請確認你的班機從哪一座航廈出發。

examples.en: The bus terminal is only five minutes from my house.
examples.zh: 公車總站離我家只要五分鐘。

examples.en: Each terminal in the computer lab is connected to the network.
examples.zh: 電腦教室裡的每一台終端機都連上了網路。

examples.en: The doctor explained that the disease was in its terminal stage.
examples.zh: 醫生說明這種疾病已進入末期。

examples.en: The train stops at the terminal station at midnight.
examples.zh: 火車在午夜停靠終點站。

examples.en: Terminal illness is a hard subject for many families.
examples.zh: 絕症對許多家庭來說是個沉重的話題。

examples.en: Sudden thunder terrifies my little brother, who hides under his blanket.
examples.zh: 突如其來的雷聲讓我弟弟嚇壞，躲進毯子底下。

examples.en: The horror movie terrified the whole class.
examples.zh: 那部恐怖片嚇壞了全班同學。

examples.en: The thought of speaking in public terrifies her.
examples.zh: 在公眾面前說話的念頭讓她很害怕。

examples.en: The theft of her bike was reported to the police.
examples.zh: 她的腳踏車失竊一事已向警方報案。

examples.en: Theft in the neighborhood has dropped this year.
examples.zh: 今年這一帶的竊盜案減少了。

examples.en: The store installed cameras to prevent theft.
examples.zh: 這家店裝了監視器來防止竊盜。

examples.en: She goes to physical therapy twice a week.
examples.zh: 她每週去做兩次物理治療。

examples.en: Music therapy can help people relax during a stressful hospital stay.
examples.zh: 音樂療法能幫助人們在充滿壓力的住院期間放鬆。

examples.en: The doctor recommended therapy for his back pain.
examples.zh: 醫生建議他針對背痛接受治療。

examples.en: Tin is often used to coat other metals.
examples.zh: 錫常被用來鍍在其他金屬上。

examples.en: She opened a tin of tomatoes for the sauce.
examples.zh: 她打開一罐番茄來做醬汁。

examples.en: Grandma keeps cookies in an old tin.
examples.zh: 奶奶把餅乾放在一個舊鐵罐裡。

examples.en: The runner carried the torch into the stadium.
examples.zh: 跑者把火炬帶進了體育場。

examples.en: Bring a torch because the cave is very dark.
examples.zh: 帶一支手電筒吧，因為洞穴裡很暗。

examples.en: The torch burned all through the ceremony.
examples.zh: 整個典禮期間火炬一直燃燒著。

examples.en: The two countries signed a peace treaty last year.
examples.zh: 兩國去年簽訂了和平條約。

examples.en: The treaty protects rare animals from being traded.
examples.zh: 這項條約保護稀有動物不被買賣。

examples.en: Students studied the treaty in their history class.
examples.zh: 學生們在歷史課上研讀了這份條約。

examples.en: She undertook the task of organizing the school fair.
examples.zh: 她承擔了籌辦學校園遊會的任務。

examples.en: The company will undertake a study of customer needs.
examples.zh: 公司將著手進行一項顧客需求的研究。

examples.en: He undertook to finish the report by Friday.
examples.zh: 他承諾在週五前完成報告。

examples.en: The teacher gave a vague answer to my question.
examples.zh: 老師對我的問題給了含糊的答覆。

examples.en: I have only a vague memory of that trip.
examples.zh: 我對那趟旅行只有模糊的記憶。

examples.en: The instructions were too vague to follow.
examples.zh: 這些說明太不明確，很難照著做。

examples.en: Their new venture sells handmade soap online.
examples.zh: 他們的新事業在網路上販售手工肥皂。

examples.en: Starting a restaurant is always a risky venture.
examples.zh: 開餐廳一直是有風險的事業。

examples.en: The two friends began a business venture after college.
examples.zh: 兩位朋友大學畢業後展開了一項創業計畫。

examples.en: We did not venture outside during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間我們沒有冒險外出。

examples.en: She ventured to ask the boss for a raise.
examples.zh: 她大膽地向老闆要求加薪。

examples.en: Few tourists venture into this remote village.
examples.zh: 很少有遊客敢深入這個偏遠的村莊。

examples.en: The newest version of the app is easier to use.
examples.zh: 這款應用程式的最新版本比較好用。

examples.en: I read the English version of the book first.
examples.zh: 我先讀了這本書的英文版。

examples.en: Each witness gave a different version of the story.
examples.zh: 每位目擊者對事情的說法都不一樣。

examples.en: The volcano erupted for the first time in fifty years.
examples.zh: 這座火山五十年來第一次噴發。

examples.en: We hiked up a volcano on our trip to Japan.
examples.zh: 我們去日本旅行時爬了一座火山。

examples.en: Many hot springs in Taiwan are near an old volcano.
examples.zh: 台灣有許多溫泉位於一座舊火山附近。

examples.en: Heavy rain caused widespread flooding across the south.
examples.zh: 大雨在南部造成大範圍的淹水。

examples.en: There is widespread support for the new bike lanes.
examples.zh: 新設的自行車道獲得廣泛的支持。

examples.en: The flu became widespread in schools this winter.
examples.zh: 今年冬天流感在各學校間蔓延開來。

examples.en: They spent a week camping in the wilderness.
examples.zh: 他們在荒野露營了一個星期。

examples.en: The park protects a large area of wilderness.
examples.zh: 這座公園保護了一大片荒野。

examples.en: It is easy to get lost in the wilderness without a map.
examples.zh: 沒有地圖的話，在荒野裡很容易迷路。

examples.en: The island is famous for its rich wildlife.
examples.zh: 這座島以豐富的野生動物聞名。

examples.en: Visitors should not feed the wildlife in the park.
examples.zh: 遊客不應該餵食公園裡的野生動物。

examples.en: We watched a documentary about African wildlife.
examples.zh: 我們看了一部關於非洲野生動物的紀錄片。

senses.zh: 工作坊（實作研習活動）；工坊

examples.en: I joined a cooking workshop last Saturday.
examples.zh: 我上週六參加了一場烹飪工作坊。

examples.en: The teachers attended a workshop on classroom management.
examples.zh: 老師們參加了一場班級經營研習會。

examples.en: My uncle makes wooden chairs in his workshop.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在他的工作室裡製作木椅。

senses.zh: 值得投入時間或心力的

examples.en: Learning a second language is a worthwhile effort.
examples.zh: 學習第二語言值得付出努力。

examples.en: The long walk was worthwhile because the view was beautiful.
examples.zh: 走這麼遠的路很值得，因為風景很美。

examples.en: Do you think the trip will be worthwhile?
examples.zh: 你覺得這趟旅行會值得嗎？

examples.en: The student was worthy of the scholarship.
examples.zh: 這位學生配得上這份獎學金。

examples.en: This is a worthy cause, so we should donate.
examples.zh: 這是個值得支持的善舉，所以我們應該捐款。

examples.en: Her kindness is worthy of praise.
examples.zh: 她的善良值得稱讚。

examples.en: The school decided to abolish the old dress code.
examples.zh: 學校決定廢除舊的服裝規定。

examples.en: Many countries have abolished the death penalty.
examples.zh: 許多國家已經廢除死刑。

examples.en: They want to abolish the fee for entering the museum.
examples.zh: 他們想取消博物館的入場費。

examples.en: The law on abortion is a topic of debate in many countries.
examples.zh: 墮胎的相關法律在許多國家是個辯論的話題。

examples.en: The doctor explained the health risks of an abortion.
examples.zh: 醫生說明了墮胎對健康的風險。

examples.en: Students read an article about abortion in their civics class.
examples.zh: 學生們在公民課上讀了一篇關於墮胎的文章。

examples.en: The bus came to an abrupt stop.
examples.zh: 公車突然停了下來。

examples.en: His abrupt answer surprised everyone in the meeting.
examples.zh: 他唐突的回答讓會議上的每個人都嚇了一跳。

examples.en: There was an abrupt change in the weather this afternoon.
examples.zh: 今天下午天氣突然改變。

examples.en: It is absurd to wear a coat in this heat.
examples.zh: 在這種大熱天穿大衣實在荒謬。

examples.en: The price of the shirt was absurd.
examples.zh: 這件襯衫的價格貴得離譜。

examples.en: Everyone laughed at his absurd excuse for being late.
examples.zh: 大家都嘲笑他遲到時那個荒謬的藉口。

examples.en: Taiwan has abundant rainfall in the summer.
examples.zh: 台灣夏季雨量充沛。

examples.en: The farm produces an abundant supply of vegetables.
examples.zh: 這座農場出產大量的蔬菜。

examples.en: Fish were abundant in the river years ago.
examples.zh: 多年前這條河裡的魚很多。

examples.en: The driver accelerated when the light turned green.
examples.zh: 綠燈亮起時，司機加速前進。

examples.en: Exercise can accelerate your recovery from an illness.
examples.zh: 運動能加快你從疾病中康復的速度。

examples.en: The company hopes to accelerate its growth next year.
examples.zh: 公司希望明年加快成長的腳步。

senses.zh: 可到達的；無障礙的；易懂的

examples.en: The library is easily accessible by MRT.
examples.zh: 搭捷運很容易到達這間圖書館。

examples.en: The new building is accessible to people in wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 這棟新大樓有無障礙設施，輪椅使用者也能進出。

examples.en: Our teacher makes the lessons accessible to every student.
examples.zh: 我們的老師讓每位學生都能輕鬆理解課程。

examples.en: My sister studies accounting at a university in Taipei.
examples.zh: 我姊姊在台北的一所大學讀會計。

examples.en: The accounting department checks every receipt.
examples.zh: 會計部門會檢查每一張收據。

examples.en: He found a job in accounting after graduation.
examples.zh: 他畢業後找到一份會計的工作。

examples.en: He acknowledged that he had made a mistake.
examples.zh: 他承認自己犯了錯。

examples.en: Please acknowledge this email as soon as you receive it.
examples.zh: 收到這封電子郵件後，請盡快回覆確認。

examples.en: The author acknowledged the help of her teachers in the book.
examples.zh: 作者在書中對老師們的協助表示感謝。

senses.zh: 收購；習得；新取得的物品

examples.en: The company announced the acquisition of a small software firm.
examples.zh: 公司宣布收購一家小型軟體公司。

examples.en: The researchers studied how social interaction supports language acquisition in young children.
examples.zh: 研究人員探討社交互動如何幫助幼童習得語言。

examples.en: The museum's latest acquisition is a famous painting.
examples.zh: 博物館最近取得的收藏是一幅名畫。

examples.en: The activist gave a speech about protecting the local river.
examples.zh: 這位運動人士發表了保護當地河川的演說。

examples.en: Several student activists handed out flyers outside the library.
examples.zh: 幾位學生運動人士在圖書館外發傳單。

examples.en: My aunt is an animal rights activist and volunteers at a shelter.
examples.zh: 我阿姨是動物權益運動人士，還在收容所當志工。

examples.en: The doctor diagnosed an acute infection that required immediate treatment.
examples.zh: 醫師診斷出一種需要立即治療的急性感染。

examples.en: Dogs have an acute sense of smell.
examples.zh: 狗的嗅覺很敏銳。

examples.en: The city is facing an acute shortage of water this summer.
examples.zh: 這座城市今年夏天面臨嚴重缺水。

examples.en: She works in the administrative office of the school.
examples.zh: 她在學校的行政辦公室工作。

examples.en: Please bring your ID to the administrative building.
examples.zh: 請帶身分證到行政大樓。

examples.en: The company hired two assistants to handle administrative tasks.
examples.zh: 公司聘請了兩位助理來處理行政事務。

examples.en: The school administrator sent an email to all parents.
examples.zh: 學校的行政人員寄了一封電子郵件給所有家長。

examples.en: Please ask the network administrator to reset your password.
examples.zh: 請網路管理員幫你重設密碼。

examples.en: The hospital administrator announced a new visiting schedule.
examples.zh: 醫院的行政主管宣布了新的探病時間表。

examples.en: An adolescent needs plenty of sleep to grow well.
examples.zh: 青少年需要充足的睡眠才能好好成長。

examples.en: The doctor gave advice to parents of adolescents.
examples.zh: 醫生給青少年的家長一些建議。

examples.en: Many adolescents spend hours on their phones every night.
examples.zh: 許多青少年每晚花好幾個小時滑手機。

examples.en: The book is about adolescent friendships and school life.
examples.zh: 這本書談的是青少年的友誼與校園生活。

examples.en: He went through an awkward adolescent stage last year.
examples.zh: 他去年經歷了尷尬的青春期。

examples.en: The clinic offers help for adolescent health problems.
examples.zh: 這間診所提供青少年健康問題的協助。

examples.en: The children adore their grandmother, who often tells them funny bedtime stories.
examples.zh: 孩子們非常愛他們的奶奶，她常在睡前講有趣的故事給他們聽。

examples.en: I adore this café because it has a quiet garden.
examples.zh: 我超愛這間咖啡店，因為它有一座安靜的花園。

examples.en: She adores her little brother and always plays with him.
examples.zh: 她非常疼愛弟弟，總是陪他玩。

examples.en: Adverse weather forced the school to cancel the trip.
examples.zh: 惡劣的天氣迫使學校取消了旅行。

examples.en: The medicine may have adverse effects on some people.
examples.zh: 這種藥可能對某些人有不良影響。

examples.en: Rising prices had an adverse effect on small shops.
examples.zh: 物價上漲對小商店造成不利的影響。

examples.en: She is a strong advocate of healthy school lunches.
examples.zh: 她是健康營養午餐的堅定倡導者。

examples.en: The mayor is an advocate for more bike lanes.
examples.zh: 市長是增設自行車道的支持者。

examples.en: As an advocate for children, he visits schools every month.
examples.zh: 身為兒童權益的倡導者，他每個月都會拜訪學校。

examples.en: Our teacher advocates reading at least twenty minutes a day.
examples.zh: 我們老師提倡每天至少閱讀二十分鐘。

examples.en: Many parents advocate limiting the time children spend on homework.
examples.zh: 許多家長提倡限制孩子做家庭作業的時間。

examples.en: The group advocates cleaner public transportation.
examples.zh: 這個團體提倡更潔淨的大眾運輸。

senses.zh: 議程；優先處理事項；目的

examples.en: The first item on the agenda is the budget.
examples.zh: 議程上的第一項是預算。

examples.en: She wondered whether he had a hidden agenda when he offered to help.
examples.zh: 他提出協助時，她想知道他是否另有目的。

examples.en: Climate change is high on the agenda this year.
examples.zh: 氣候變遷是今年的重要議題。

examples.en: The teacher talked with him about his aggression in class.
examples.zh: 老師和他談了他在班上的攻擊行為。

examples.en: Some animals show aggression when they feel afraid.
examples.zh: 有些動物在害怕時會表現出攻擊性。

examples.en: The two countries signed an agreement to end aggression and settle disputes peacefully.
examples.zh: 兩國簽署協議，停止侵略並以和平方式解決爭端。

examples.en: She was in agony after she twisted her ankle.
examples.zh: 她扭傷腳踝後痛得要命。

examples.en: We waited in agony for the exam results.
examples.zh: 我們痛苦地等待考試成績。

examples.en: His face showed the agony of losing the final game.
examples.zh: 他的臉上露出輸掉決賽的痛苦。

examples.en: This region is famous for its agricultural products.
examples.zh: 這個地區以農產品聞名。

examples.en: My uncle studies agricultural science at university.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在大學讀農業科學。

examples.en: The government gave money to improve agricultural tools.
examples.zh: 政府撥款改善農業器具。

examples.en: The snacks are in the third aisle of the supermarket.
examples.zh: 零食在超市的第三條走道。

examples.en: I would like an aisle seat on the plane.
examples.zh: 我想要飛機上靠走道的座位。

examples.en: The bride walked slowly down the aisle.
examples.zh: 新娘沿著走道緩緩前行。

senses.zh: 外星人；外國人（法律用語）

examples.en: The movie is about an alien who visits Earth.
examples.zh: 這部電影講的是一個造訪地球的外星人。

examples.en: Under this law, aliens must present valid passports when applying for residence.
examples.zh: 依這項法律，外國人申請居留時必須出示有效護照。

examples.en: The kids dressed up as aliens for the school party.
examples.zh: 孩子們在學校派對上打扮成外星人。

examples.en: The city felt alien to her on the first day.
examples.zh: 第一天她覺得這座城市很陌生。

examples.en: The island's native plants were threatened by an alien species of insect.
examples.zh: 這座島的原生植物受到一種外來昆蟲的威脅。

examples.en: Scientists wonder whether alien life exists on other planets.
examples.zh: 科學家好奇其他行星上是否有外星生命。

examples.en: I am allergic to peanuts, so I never eat them.
examples.zh: 我對花生過敏，所以從不吃。

examples.en: Her son is allergic to cat hair.
examples.zh: 她的兒子對貓毛過敏。

examples.en: "Are you allergic to any medicine?" the nurse asked before the examination.
examples.zh: 「你對任何藥物過敏嗎？」護理師在檢查前問道。

examples.en: She has an allergy to dust and sneezes when cleaning old books.
examples.zh: 她對灰塵過敏，清理舊書時會打噴嚏。

examples.en: Pollen allergy is common in spring when many flowers and trees bloom.
examples.zh: 春天許多花木開花時，花粉過敏很常見。

examples.en: Please tell the waiter about your food allergy.
examples.zh: 請告訴服務生你的食物過敏情況。

examples.en: The two companies formed an alliance to share ideas.
examples.zh: 兩家公司結成聯盟來分享想法。

examples.en: Several countries joined the alliance last year.
examples.zh: 去年有幾個國家加入了這個聯盟。

examples.en: Their alliance helped the small team win the contest.
examples.zh: 他們的結盟幫助這支小隊贏得比賽。

examples.en: The school will allocate more money to the library.
examples.zh: 學校會撥更多經費給圖書館。

examples.en: We need to allocate time for review before the exam.
examples.zh: 我們得在考前安排複習的時間。

examples.en: The manager allocated each member a different task.
examples.zh: 經理分配給每位成員不同的任務。

examples.en: Our country has many allies in the region.
examples.zh: 我們國家在這個地區有許多盟友。

examples.en: She found an ally in her classmate during the debate.
examples.zh: 辯論時，她在同學身上找到了支持者。

examples.en: A good friend is a strong ally in hard times.
examples.zh: 好朋友在艱困時期是強力的支持者。

examples.en: The small shops decided to ally with each other.
examples.zh: 這些小商店決定彼此結盟。

examples.en: Several clubs allied to organize the charity event.
examples.zh: 幾個社團聯合舉辦了慈善活動。

examples.en: He allied himself with the students who wanted a longer break.
examples.zh: 他和想要更長休息時間的學生站在同一陣線。

examples.en: The tailor can alter these pants to fit you.
examples.zh: 裁縫師可以把這件褲子改成適合你的尺寸。

examples.en: We had to alter our plans because of the typhoon.
examples.zh: 因為颱風，我們得更改計畫。

examples.en: Nothing could alter her decision to study abroad.
examples.zh: 什麼都無法改變她出國念書的決定。

examples.en: The two brothers alternate washing the dishes each night.
examples.zh: 兩兄弟每晚輪流洗碗。

examples.en: Sunny days alternate with rainy ones in spring.
examples.zh: 春天晴天與雨天交替出現。

examples.en: She alternates between tea and coffee in the morning.
examples.zh: 她早上輪流喝茶和咖啡。

senses.zh: 交替的；替代的；隔一個的

examples.en: We take an alternate route when the highway is crowded.
examples.zh: 高速公路壅塞時，我們會走替代路線。

examples.en: The gym is open on alternate days.
examples.zh: 健身房每隔一天開放一次。

examples.en: The scarf has alternate stripes of blue and white.
examples.zh: 這條圍巾上有藍白相間的條紋。

examples.en: The club decided to amend its rules about membership.
examples.zh: 社團決定修訂會員規定。

examples.en: Please amend the report before you send it to the manager.
examples.zh: 寄給經理之前請先修正這份報告。

examples.en: The city council voted to amend the traffic law.
examples.zh: 市議會投票通過修訂交通法規。

examples.en: There is ample parking behind the shopping mall.
examples.zh: 購物中心後方有充足的停車位。

examples.en: You have ample time to finish the test.
examples.zh: 你有充裕的時間寫完考卷。

examples.en: The new apartment has ample space for our books.
examples.zh: 新公寓有寬敞的空間放我們的書。

examples.en: An anonymous student left a gift on the teacher's desk.
examples.zh: 一位不具名的學生在老師桌上留下禮物。

examples.en: The survey is anonymous, so you do not need to write your name.
examples.zh: 這份問卷是匿名的，所以不用寫名字。

examples.en: The letter was sent by an anonymous writer.
examples.zh: 這封信是由匿名寄件者寄出的。

examples.en: We anticipate a large crowd at the concert tonight.
examples.zh: 我們預期今晚的演唱會會有很多人。

examples.en: The store anticipated high sales before the holiday.
examples.zh: 商店預期假期前銷量會很高。

examples.en: She anticipated the question and had an answer ready.
examples.zh: 她預料到這個問題，早就準備好答案。

examples.en: My grandfather collects antiques from different countries.
examples.zh: 我爺爺收集各國的古董。

examples.en: This clock is an antique from the 1800s.
examples.zh: 這座時鐘是十九世紀的古董。

examples.en: There is an antique shop at the corner of the street.
examples.zh: 街角有一家古董店。

senses.zh: 古老的（常指有收藏價值的物品）

examples.en: She bought an antique chair at the flea market.
examples.zh: 她在跳蚤市場買了一把古董椅。

examples.en: The antique vase is displayed in a glass case.
examples.zh: 那只古董花瓶陳列在玻璃櫃裡。

examples.en: They live in a house full of antique furniture.
examples.zh: 他們住在一間滿是古董家具的房子裡。

examples.en: Children are apt to catch colds in winter.
examples.zh: 孩子在冬天容易感冒。

examples.en: He is apt to forget his keys when he is in a hurry.
examples.zh: 他趕時間時很容易忘記帶鑰匙。

examples.en: The title of the book is very apt.
examples.zh: 這本書的書名非常貼切。

examples.en: Thousands of fans filled the arena to watch the game.
examples.zh: 數千名球迷擠滿了體育館觀賽。

examples.en: The concert will be held at the new arena downtown.
examples.zh: 演唱會將在市中心的新體育館舉行。

examples.en: She is well known in the political arena.
examples.zh: 她在政壇上很有名。

examples.en: The shop sells a wide array of school supplies.
examples.zh: 這家店販售各式各樣的文具。

examples.en: The menu offers an array of vegetarian dishes.
examples.zh: 菜單上有許多素食料理可選。

examples.en: In class, we learned how to store numbers in an array.
examples.zh: 我們在課堂上學到如何把數字存在陣列裡。

examples.en: He became arrogant after winning the speech contest.
examples.zh: 他贏得演講比賽後變得很自大。

examples.en: Nobody likes an arrogant boss who refuses to listen to other people's ideas.
examples.zh: 沒有人喜歡拒絕聽取他人想法的傲慢老闆。

examples.en: Her arrogant manner made it hard to work with her.
examples.zh: 她傲慢的態度讓人很難與她共事。

examples.en: She is an articulate speaker who explains ideas clearly.
examples.zh: 她是個表達清楚的講者，能把想法說得很明白。

examples.en: The articulate student impressed the judges with her clear explanation of the experiment.
examples.zh: 那位學生善於表達，清楚說明實驗，讓評審印象深刻。

examples.en: He is shy, but he is very articulate in writing.
examples.zh: 他很害羞，但文字表達能力很強。

examples.en: It is hard to articulate how happy I feel right now.
examples.zh: 很難說清楚我現在有多開心。

examples.en: Can you articulate your idea in one sentence?
examples.zh: 你能用一句話把你的想法說清楚嗎？

examples.en: She tried to articulate her worries to her parents.
examples.zh: 她試著向父母清楚表達自己的擔憂。

senses.zh: 驢子；笨蛋（冒犯用語）；屁股（粗俗）

examples.en: The farmer rode an ass to the market.
examples.zh: 農夫騎著驢子去市場。

examples.en: He realized he had made an ass of himself by ignoring the clear instructions.
examples.zh: 他發現自己無視清楚的指示，結果出了洋相。

examples.en: During the lesson, we learned that "ass" can be a rude word for someone's bottom.
examples.zh: 課堂上，我們學到「ass」也可以是指人屁股的粗俗用語。

senses.zh: 襲擊；猛烈攻勢；言語攻擊

examples.en: The police said the assault happened late at night.
examples.zh: 警方表示襲擊事件發生在深夜。

examples.en: The team launched a strong assault on the goal in the second half.
examples.zh: 球隊在下半場對球門發動猛烈攻勢。

examples.en: The new rules protect workers from verbal assault.
examples.zh: 新規定保護員工免受言語攻擊。

examples.en: The law punishes anyone who assaults a stranger.
examples.zh: 法律會懲罰任何攻擊陌生人的人。

examples.en: The player was warned for trying to assault the referee.
examples.zh: 那名球員因企圖攻擊裁判而被警告。

examples.en: Critics assaulted the plan in the newspaper.
examples.zh: 評論家在報紙上猛烈抨擊這項計畫。

examples.en: He asserted that he had finished his homework.
examples.zh: 他斷言自己已經寫完功課。

examples.en: The witness asserted that she saw the car stop.
examples.zh: 目擊者聲稱她看到那輛車停下來。

examples.en: You should assert your rights as a customer.
examples.zh: 你應該堅持自己身為顧客的權利。

examples.en: Teachers assess students with tests and projects.
examples.zh: 老師用考試和專題來評量學生。

examples.en: An expert came to assess the damage to the roof.
examples.zh: 專家前來評估屋頂的損壞程度。

examples.en: An expert assessed the house at eight million dollars before the sale.
examples.zh: 專家在出售前估定這棟房子的價值為八百萬元。

examples.en: The plan is based on the assumption that sales will grow.
examples.zh: 這個計畫是以銷量會成長為前提。

examples.en: It is a wrong assumption that all teenagers dislike reading.
examples.zh: 認為所有青少年都不愛閱讀是錯誤的假設。

examples.en: Don't make an assumption before you check the facts.
examples.zh: 在查證事實前不要妄下定論。

senses.zh: 競技體育（美式）；田徑運動（英式）

examples.en: Our school has a strong athletics program.
examples.zh: 我們學校的體育訓練體系很完善。

examples.en: She won a medal in athletics at the national games.
examples.zh: 她在全國運動會的田徑賽中贏得一面獎牌。

examples.en: Athletics is a good way for students to stay healthy.
examples.zh: 體育活動是學生保持健康的好方法。

examples.en: The teacher takes attendance at the start of every class.
examples.zh: 老師每節課一開始都會點名。

examples.en: Attendance at the meeting is required for all staff.
examples.zh: 全體員工都必須出席這場會議。

examples.en: Attendance at the concert was higher than we expected.
examples.zh: 演唱會的出席人數比我們預期的多。

examples.en: We keep old boxes and toys in the attic.
examples.zh: 我們把舊箱子和玩具放在閣樓。

examples.en: She found her father's old camera in the attic.
examples.zh: 她在閣樓裡找到爸爸的舊相機。

examples.en: It gets very hot in the attic during summer.
examples.zh: 閣樓在夏天會變得非常熱。

examples.en: The attorney explained the contract to my parents.
examples.zh: 律師向我父母解釋了合約內容。

examples.en: She works as an attorney for a large company.
examples.zh: 她在一家大公司擔任律師。

examples.en: You may want to ask an attorney before signing the paper.
examples.zh: 簽署這份文件前，你或許該先請教律師。

senses.zh: 歸因於；認為是某人的作品

examples.en: She attributes her success to hard work.
examples.zh: 她把成功歸功於努力。

examples.en: The teacher attributed the mistake to a lack of sleep.
examples.zh: 老師認為這個錯誤是因為睡眠不足。

examples.en: This song is often attributed to a famous Taiwanese singer.
examples.zh: 這首歌常被認為是一位知名台灣歌手的作品。

examples.en: Honesty is an important attribute of a good friend.
examples.zh: 誠實是好朋友的重要特質。

examples.en: Each object in the program has its own attributes.
examples.zh: 程式中的每個物件都有自己的屬性。

examples.en: Patience is one attribute every teacher needs.
examples.zh: 耐心是每位老師都需要的特質。

examples.en: The painting was sold at an auction for a high price.
examples.zh: 那幅畫在拍賣會上以高價賣出。

examples.en: We went to a charity auction on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我們週六去參加了慈善拍賣會。

examples.en: The old furniture will be put up for auction next week.
examples.zh: 這些舊家具下週將被送去拍賣。

examples.en: The school will auction donated books to raise money.
examples.zh: 學校會拍賣捐贈的書籍來籌款。

examples.en: They plan to auction the old house next month.
examples.zh: 他們打算下個月拍賣那棟老房子。

examples.en: The museum auctioned several rare coins last year.
examples.zh: 博物館去年拍賣了幾枚稀有的硬幣。

examples.en: The manager authorized the purchase of new computers.
examples.zh: 經理批准購買新電腦。

examples.en: Only staff members are authorized to enter this room.
examples.zh: 只有工作人員獲准進入這個房間。

examples.en: Please authorize the payment with your password.
examples.zh: 請輸入密碼以授權這筆付款。

examples.en: The school gives teachers autonomy in choosing books.
examples.zh: 學校給老師選書的自主權。

examples.en: Teenagers want more autonomy from their parents.
examples.zh: 青少年希望從父母那裡獲得更多自主權。

examples.en: The region has some autonomy in making local rules.
examples.zh: 這個地區在制定地方規定上有一定的自治權。

examples.en: The children looked at the huge dinosaur bones in awe.
examples.zh: 孩子們驚嘆地看著巨大的恐龍骨頭。

examples.en: She stood in awe of the mountain view.
examples.zh: 她對眼前的山景感到敬畏。

examples.en: The students listened with awe to the astronaut's story.
examples.zh: 學生們懷著敬佩的心聆聽太空人的故事。

examples.en: Please put your ballot in the box.
examples.zh: 請把你的選票投進箱子裡。

examples.en: The class chose a leader by secret ballot.
examples.zh: 全班用無記名投票選出班長。

examples.en: Voters received a ballot at the school gym.
examples.zh: 選民在學校體育館領取選票。

examples.en: A large banner hung above the school gate.
examples.zh: 學校大門上方掛著一條大橫幅。

examples.en: The fans held up a banner to cheer for the team.
examples.zh: 球迷舉起布條為球隊加油。

examples.en: The shop put a sale banner in the window.
examples.zh: 商店在櫥窗掛上特賣布條。

examples.en: The barren land could not grow any crops.
examples.zh: 那片貧瘠的土地種不出任何作物。

examples.en: We hiked across a barren hill with no trees.
examples.zh: 我們健行穿越一座沒有樹木的荒山。

examples.en: The farmers worked hard to turn the barren field green.
examples.zh: 農民努力把荒蕪的田地變成一片綠意。

examples.en: Mom baked a fresh batch of cookies for the party.
examples.zh: 媽媽為派對烤了一爐新鮮的餅乾。

examples.en: The factory sent out the first batch of products on Monday.
examples.zh: 工廠週一送出了第一批產品。

examples.en: A new batch of students will arrive next week.
examples.zh: 下週會有一批新生到校。

senses.zh: 代表身分；利益（均用於固定片語）

examples.en: I am writing this email on behalf of our class.
examples.zh: 我代表我們班寫這封電子郵件。

examples.en: She accepted the prize on behalf of the whole team.
examples.zh: 她代表整個團隊領獎。

examples.en: Don't worry on my behalf; I can take care of myself.
examples.zh: 不用為我擔心；我可以照顧自己。

examples.en: Please keep your belongings with you at all times.
examples.zh: 請隨時把你的個人物品帶在身邊。

examples.en: She packed her belongings into two small suitcases.
examples.zh: 她把自己的物品裝進兩個小行李箱。

examples.en: The hotel will store your belongings until you check in.
examples.zh: 飯店會在你辦理入住前保管你的物品。

examples.en: The family buried their beloved dog in the garden.
examples.zh: 全家人把心愛的狗埋在花園裡。

examples.en: Our beloved teacher is retiring next month.
examples.zh: 我們深受喜愛的老師下個月就要退休了。

examples.en: This beloved song is played at every school graduation.
examples.zh: 這首深受喜愛的歌在每場畢業典禮上都會播放。

examples.en: A good friend would never betray your trust.
examples.zh: 好朋友絕不會辜負你的信任。

examples.en: He felt that his partner had betrayed him.
examples.zh: 他覺得他的合夥人背叛了他。

examples.en: Her shaky voice seemed to betray how nervous she was.
examples.zh: 她顫抖的聲音似乎洩漏了她有多緊張。

examples.en: Beware of pickpockets when you are on the crowded train.
examples.zh: 在擁擠的火車上要小心扒手。

examples.en: The sign said, "Beware of the dog."
examples.zh: 告示牌上寫著：「小心惡犬。」

examples.en: You should beware of emails asking for your password.
examples.zh: 你應該提防要求你提供密碼的電子郵件。

examples.en: The teacher showed no bias toward any student.
examples.zh: 老師對任何學生都沒有偏袒。

examples.en: Many people have a bias against people who are late.
examples.zh: 許多人對遲到的人有偏見。

examples.en: The survey results may contain some bias.
examples.zh: 這份問卷調查的結果可能含有一些偏差。

examples.en: Do not let one bad review bias your opinion of the movie.
examples.zh: 別讓一則負評使你對這部電影產生成見。

examples.en: Repeated advertising can bias customers toward familiar brands rather than new ones.
examples.zh: 反覆出現的廣告可能使顧客偏向熟悉的品牌，而不是新品牌。

examples.en: His past experience may bias him against the new plan.
examples.zh: 他過去的經驗可能使他對新計畫抱有成見。

examples.en: We learned about biological changes during biology class.
examples.zh: 我們在生物課上學到了生物方面的變化。

examples.en: She met her biological mother for the first time last year.
examples.zh: 她去年第一次見到自己的親生母親。

examples.en: Scientists study the biological functions of the human body.
examples.zh: 科學家研究人體的生物機能。

examples.en: I had a bizarre dream about flying elephants last night.
examples.zh: 我昨晚做了一個關於會飛的大象的怪夢。

examples.en: It was bizarre to see snow in the middle of summer.
examples.zh: 在仲夏看到下雪真是奇怪。

examples.en: The museum has a bizarre collection of old clocks.
examples.zh: 這間博物館有一批古怪的老時鐘收藏。

senses.zh: 爆炸；一股強勁氣流；巨響

examples.en: The blast shook the windows of the nearby buildings.
examples.zh: 爆炸聲震動了附近大樓的窗戶。

examples.en: A blast of cold air hit us when we opened the door.
examples.zh: 我們一開門，一陣冷風迎面吹來。

examples.en: The speakers made a loud blast of music.
examples.zh: 喇叭播出了震耳的樂聲。

examples.en: Workers blasted a tunnel through the mountain.
examples.zh: 工人在山中炸出了一條隧道。

examples.en: My neighbor blasts music every Saturday night.
examples.zh: 我的鄰居每個週六晚上都把音樂開得很大聲。

examples.en: The engineers blasted the old bridge to make way for a new one.
examples.zh: 工程師爆破舊橋，為新橋讓路。

examples.en: Without my glasses, everything is a blur.
examples.zh: 沒戴眼鏡時，一切都模糊不清。

examples.en: The cars passed by in a blur of color.
examples.zh: 車子在一片模糊的色彩中呼嘯而過。

examples.en: The long day felt like a blur to me.
examples.zh: 那漫長的一天對我來說像是一片模糊。

examples.en: Tears blurred her vision as she waved goodbye.
examples.zh: 她揮手道別時，淚水模糊了視線。

examples.en: Fog can blur the lines on the road.
examples.zh: 霧可能會讓路上的線條變得模糊。

examples.en: The photo blurred because I moved the camera.
examples.zh: 因為我移動了相機，照片變模糊了。

examples.en: The singer arrived with two bodyguards as fans gathered outside the theater.
examples.zh: 歌迷聚集在劇院外時，那位歌手帶著兩名保鑣抵達。

examples.en: A bodyguard stood quietly beside the president.
examples.zh: 一名保鑣安靜地站在總統身旁。

examples.en: He works as a bodyguard for a famous actress.
examples.zh: 他擔任一位知名女演員的保鑣。

examples.en: Use a wrench to tighten the bolt on the chair leg.
examples.zh: 用扳手鎖緊椅腳上的螺栓。

examples.en: She slid the bolt across to lock the door.
examples.zh: 她推上門閂把門鎖好。

examples.en: A bolt of lightning lit up the sky.
examples.zh: 一道閃電照亮了天空。

examples.en: Please bolt the door before you go to bed.
examples.zh: 睡覺前請把門閂上。

examples.en: The workers bolted the shelf to the wall.
examples.zh: 工人把架子用螺栓固定在牆上。

examples.en: The rabbit bolted across the yard when it heard a noise.
examples.zh: 兔子聽到聲響後飛奔過院子。

examples.en: All employees received a bonus at the end of the year.
examples.zh: 所有員工在年底都領到了獎金。

examples.en: The free ticket was a nice bonus.
examples.zh: 免費的票是個不錯的額外好處。

examples.en: You will get a bonus point if you answer this question.
examples.zh: 回答這一題就能得到一分加分。

examples.en: The city enjoyed a boom in tourism last summer.
examples.zh: 這座城市去年夏天旅遊業蓬勃發展。

examples.en: We heard a loud boom from the construction site.
examples.zh: 我們聽到工地傳來一聲巨響。

examples.en: The baby boom changed the school system.
examples.zh: 嬰兒潮改變了學校制度。

examples.en: Business is booming at the new coffee shop.
examples.zh: 這家新咖啡店生意興隆。

examples.en: Thunder boomed over the hills as dark clouds covered the sky.
examples.zh: 烏雲遮住天空時，雷聲在山丘上空隆隆作響。

examples.en: Online shopping has boomed in recent years.
examples.zh: 網路購物近年來快速成長。

examples.en: Eating a good breakfast can boost your energy.
examples.zh: 吃一頓豐盛的早餐可以提升你的精力。

examples.en: The new ad should boost sales this month.
examples.zh: 這則新廣告應該能提高本月的銷售量。

examples.en: A kind word can boost a child's confidence.
examples.zh: 一句溫暖的話能增強孩子的自信。

examples.en: The good grade gave her a boost in confidence.
examples.zh: 這個好成績讓她信心大增。

examples.en: Tourism gave the local economy a big boost.
examples.zh: 觀光大幅提振了當地經濟。

examples.en: Coffee gives me a quick boost in the morning.
examples.zh: 咖啡讓我早上很快就提起精神。

examples.en: We visited the food booth at the school fair.
examples.zh: 我們去逛了學校園遊會的美食攤位。

examples.en: She stepped into the phone booth to make a call.
examples.zh: 她走進電話亭打電話。

examples.en: Please vote in the booth and drop your ballot in the box.
examples.zh: 請在投票亭內投票，並把選票投入箱中。

examples.en: He read comic books to escape boredom on the long trip.
examples.zh: 他看漫畫來打發長途旅程的無聊。

examples.en: Boredom is a common reason why students lose focus.
examples.zh: 無聊是學生分心的常見原因。

examples.en: She picked up a new hobby out of boredom.
examples.zh: 她出於無聊培養了一項新嗜好。

senses.zh: 一定會的；受約束的；前往…的

examples.en: The team is bound to win if they keep practicing.
examples.zh: 如果持續練習，這支隊伍一定會贏。

examples.en: We are bound by the rules of the contract.
examples.zh: 我們受合約規定的約束。

examples.en: This train is bound for Taichung and stops at three smaller stations.
examples.zh: 這班火車開往台中，途中停靠三個較小的車站。

examples.en: The puppy bounded across the lawn to greet us.
examples.zh: 小狗蹦蹦跳跳地跑過草坪來迎接我們。

examples.en: The deer bounded away into the forest.
examples.zh: 鹿跳躍著奔進森林裡。

examples.en: Kids bounded down the stairs when the bell rang.
examples.zh: 鈴聲一響，孩子們蹦跳著衝下樓梯。

examples.en: A tall fence marks the boundary of the park.
examples.zh: 一道高高的圍籬標示出公園的邊界。

examples.en: Parents should set clear boundaries for their children.
examples.zh: 父母應該為孩子設下明確的界線。

examples.en: The river forms the boundary between the two towns.
examples.zh: 這條河形成兩個城鎮之間的分界。

senses.zh: 拳擊手；拳師犬；男用平口內褲（用複數）

examples.en: The boxer trained at the gym every morning.
examples.zh: 那位拳擊手每天早上都在健身房訓練。

examples.en: He packed two pairs of boxers and several shirts for the trip.
examples.zh: 他為這趟旅行打包了兩件平口內褲和幾件襯衫。

examples.en: A boxer is a strong and friendly dog.
examples.zh: 拳師犬是一種強壯又友善的狗。

examples.en: Scientists announced a breakthrough in cancer research.
examples.zh: 科學家宣布癌症研究有了重大突破。

examples.en: The two countries reached a breakthrough in their talks.
examples.zh: 兩國在會談中取得了突破。

examples.en: Learning to swim was a real breakthrough for him.
examples.zh: 學會游泳對他來說是個真正的突破。

examples.en: The statue in the square is made of bronze.
examples.zh: 廣場上的雕像是用青銅製成的。

examples.en: She won a bronze in the swimming contest.
examples.zh: 她在游泳比賽中拿到了一面銅牌。

examples.en: The museum displayed several small bronzes made by a local sculptor.
examples.zh: 博物館展出一位本地雕刻家製作的幾件小型銅雕。

examples.en: He has a bronze skin tone after the summer holiday.
examples.zh: 暑假過後，他的皮膚呈古銅色。

examples.en: The bronze bell rang loudly across the village.
examples.zh: 青銅鐘的鐘聲響遍整個村莊。

examples.en: They bought a bronze vase at the market.
examples.zh: 他們在市場買了一只青銅花瓶。

examples.en: She had a large bruise on her knee after the fall.
examples.zh: 她摔倒後膝蓋上有一大塊瘀青。

examples.en: The bruise turned purple after two days.
examples.zh: 兩天後瘀青變成了紫色。

examples.en: Apples with a bruise are sold at a lower price.
examples.zh: 有碰傷的蘋果會以較低的價格出售。

examples.en: Be careful not to bruise the peaches.
examples.zh: 小心別把桃子碰傷了。

examples.en: He bruised his arm while playing basketball.
examples.zh: 他打籃球時手臂撞出了瘀青。

examples.en: Bananas bruise easily if you drop them.
examples.zh: 香蕉掉到地上很容易碰傷。

examples.en: We buy rice in bulk to save money.
examples.zh: 我們大量購買米以節省開銷。

examples.en: The bulk of the work was finished by noon.
examples.zh: 大部分的工作在中午前就完成了。

examples.en: The bulk of the box made it hard to carry.
examples.zh: 箱子龐大的體積讓人很難搬動。

examples.en: The teacher spoke with the bully about his behavior.
examples.zh: 老師和那個霸凌者談了他的行為。

examples.en: No child should be afraid of a bully at school.
examples.zh: 沒有孩子該在學校怕霸凌者。

examples.en: He was a bully when he was young, but he has changed.
examples.zh: 他年輕時是個惡霸，但後來改變了。

examples.en: Some students bully others online by posting hurtful comments about them.
examples.zh: 有些學生在網路上發布傷人的留言，藉此霸凌他人。

examples.en: Tell an adult if someone tries to bully you.
examples.zh: 如果有人想欺負你，要告訴大人。

examples.en: She was bullied for wearing glasses, but her classmates stood up for her.
examples.zh: 她因為戴眼鏡而遭到霸凌，但同學挺身支持她。

senses.zh: 官僚體系；繁瑣的行政程序

examples.en: Getting a permit involves a lot of bureaucracy.
examples.zh: 申請許可證要經過很多繁瑣的行政程序。

examples.en: The government relies on a large bureaucracy to administer public services.
examples.zh: 政府仰賴龐大的官僚體系管理公共服務。

examples.en: The company wants to cut bureaucracy and work faster.
examples.zh: 公司想減少繁瑣的行政程序，加快工作速度。

examples.en: The burial took place on a quiet hillside.
examples.zh: 下葬儀式在一處寧靜的山坡上舉行。

examples.en: Family members gathered for the burial of their grandfather.
examples.zh: 家人為祖父的安葬聚在一起。

examples.en: Archaeologists found an ancient burial site near the river.
examples.zh: 考古學家在河邊發現了一處古代墓葬地。

examples.en: Milk is a good source of calcium.
examples.zh: 牛奶是鈣質的良好來源。

examples.en: Calcium helps build strong bones and teeth.
examples.zh: 鈣有助於打造強健的骨骼和牙齒。

examples.en: The doctor told her to take a calcium supplement.
examples.zh: 醫師要她服用鈣補充劑。

examples.en: She has the capability to lead the team.
examples.zh: 她有帶領團隊的能力。

examples.en: This phone has the capability to record in 4K.
examples.zh: 這支手機具備錄製4K影片的功能。

examples.en: The company is improving its production capability.
examples.zh: 公司正在提升生產能力。

examples.en: Our town holds a carnival every spring.
examples.zh: 我們鎮上每年春天都會舉辦嘉年華。

examples.en: The kids rode the Ferris wheel at the carnival.
examples.zh: 孩子們在嘉年華上搭了摩天輪。

examples.en: People wore colorful costumes to the carnival parade.
examples.zh: 人們穿著色彩繽紛的服裝參加嘉年華遊行。

examples.en: The hotel has a large casino on the first floor.
examples.zh: 這間飯店一樓有一間大型賭場。

examples.en: Minors are not allowed to enter the casino.
examples.zh: 未成年人不得進入賭場。

examples.en: They visited a casino during their trip to Macau.
examples.zh: 他們到澳門旅遊時去了一間賭場。

examples.en: The cathedral was built more than 600 years ago.
examples.zh: 這座大教堂建於六百多年前。

examples.en: Tourists took photos in front of the old cathedral.
examples.zh: 遊客在古老的大教堂前拍照。

examples.en: The choir sang inside the cathedral on Christmas Eve.
examples.zh: 聖誕夜，合唱團在大教堂裡獻唱。

examples.en: Please walk with caution on the wet floor.
examples.zh: 濕滑的地板請小心行走。

examples.en: He crossed the busy road with great caution.
examples.zh: 他非常謹慎地穿越繁忙的馬路。

examples.en: The sign gave a caution about falling rocks.
examples.zh: 告示牌發出了落石警告。

examples.en: The teacher cautioned us not to run in the hallway.
examples.zh: 老師告誡我們不要在走廊上奔跑。

examples.en: Doctors caution people to drink plenty of water in hot weather.
examples.zh: 醫生提醒大家在炎熱的天氣要多喝水。

examples.en: She cautioned him about the icy road.
examples.zh: 她提醒他路面結冰。

examples.en: Be cautious when you cross the street at night.
examples.zh: 夜晚過馬路時要小心。

examples.en: He is cautious about spending money because he is saving for college.
examples.zh: 他花錢很謹慎，因為他正在為上大學存錢。

examples.en: The cautious driver slowed down in the fog.
examples.zh: 那位謹慎的駕駛在霧中放慢了車速。

examples.en: The celebrity waved to the fans outside the hotel.
examples.zh: 那位名人向飯店外的粉絲揮手。

examples.en: Many celebrities attended the charity event.
examples.zh: 許多名人出席了這場慈善活動。

examples.en: The actor's sudden celebrity made it difficult for him to lead a quiet life.
examples.zh: 這位演員突然成名，變得很難過平靜的生活。

examples.en: Our family visits the cemetery every spring.
examples.zh: 我們全家每年春天都會去墓園。

examples.en: The cemetery is quiet and full of old trees.
examples.zh: 這座墓園很安靜，到處是老樹。

examples.en: A path leads from the church to the cemetery.
examples.zh: 一條小路從教堂通往墓園。

examples.en: There is no certainty that it will stop raining soon.
examples.zh: 不確定雨是否很快就會停。

examples.en: He answered with certainty that the bus was late.
examples.zh: 他很肯定地回答公車誤點了。

examples.en: Nothing in life is a certainty except change.
examples.zh: 生活中除了改變之外，沒有什麼是確定的。

examples.en: The classroom was in chaos before the teacher arrived.
examples.zh: 老師到之前，教室一片混亂。

examples.en: Heavy rain caused chaos on the roads this morning.
examples.zh: 大雨使今早的道路陷入混亂。

examples.en: After the party, the kitchen was a scene of chaos.
examples.zh: 派對結束後，廚房亂成一團。

examples.en: They got married in a small chapel by the sea.
examples.zh: 他們在海邊的一間小教堂結婚。

examples.en: The school has a quiet chapel near the library.
examples.zh: 學校圖書館附近有一間安靜的小禮拜堂。

examples.en: We lit candles in the chapel before the concert.
examples.zh: 音樂會前，我們在小教堂裡點起蠟燭。

senses.zh: 描述特性；構成某事物的特徵

examples.en: Teachers often characterize him as a quiet student.
examples.zh: 老師們常形容他是個安靜的學生。

examples.en: Hot summers and mild winters characterize this region.
examples.zh: 炎熱的夏季和溫和的冬季是這個地區的特色。

examples.en: How would you characterize your relationship with your sister?
examples.zh: 你會如何形容你和姊姊的關係？

examples.en: The chef prepared a special menu for the guests.
examples.zh: 主廚為客人準備了特別菜單。

examples.en: My brother wants to become a chef someday.
examples.zh: 我哥哥將來想當廚師。

examples.en: The head chef tasted the soup before serving it.
examples.zh: 主廚在上菜前先試了湯的味道。

examples.en: She sings in the school choir and performs at every graduation ceremony.
examples.zh: 她在學校合唱團唱歌，每場畢業典禮都會參與演出。

examples.en: The church choir rehearsed a hymn for the Christmas Eve service.
examples.zh: 教堂唱詩班為聖誕夜禮拜排練了一首聖詩。

examples.en: A children's choir performed at the festival.
examples.zh: 一個兒童合唱團在慶典上表演。

examples.en: He learned three chords on the guitar in one week.
examples.zh: 他一週內學會了三個吉他和弦。

examples.en: The piano teacher showed me how to play a simple chord.
examples.zh: 鋼琴老師教我怎麼彈簡單的和弦。

examples.en: A chord is a straight line segment joining two points on a circle.
examples.zh: 弦是連接圓上兩點的直線段。

examples.en: My grandfather suffers from chronic back pain.
examples.zh: 我爺爺長期為慢性背痛所苦。

examples.en: People with chronic diseases often need regular checkups to monitor their condition.
examples.zh: 慢性病患者通常需要定期檢查，以追蹤病情。

examples.en: The city has a chronic shortage of parking spaces.
examples.zh: 這座城市長期缺乏停車位。

examples.en: She cut the cheese into small chunks.
examples.zh: 她把起司切成小塊。

examples.en: A big chunk of the cake was already gone.
examples.zh: 蛋糕已經少了一大塊。

examples.en: Writing the report took a large chunk of my weekend.
examples.zh: 寫報告佔掉了我週末相當多的時間。

senses.zh: 電路；一圈；巡迴演出路線

examples.en: The electrician checked the circuit for any damage.
examples.zh: 電工檢查電路有沒有損壞。

examples.en: We ran one circuit around the school track.
examples.zh: 我們繞著學校操場跑了一圈。

examples.en: The band tours the festival circuit every summer.
examples.zh: 這個樂團每年夏天都在各音樂節巡迴演出。

senses.zh: 引用；註明出處；開單告發

examples.en: Students must cite their sources in the report.
examples.zh: 學生必須在報告中註明資料來源。

examples.en: The writer cited a recent study to support her idea.
examples.zh: 作者引用了一項最近的研究來支持她的想法。

examples.en: The officer cited the driver for speeding.
examples.zh: 警察開單告發這名駕駛超速。

examples.en: Voting is an important civic duty in a democratic society.
examples.zh: 在民主社會中，投票是重要的公民責任。

examples.en: Our school offers a civic education class.
examples.zh: 我們學校開設公民教育課。

examples.en: The civic center hosts events for local residents.
examples.zh: 市民活動中心為當地居民舉辦各種活動。

examples.en: The teacher explained the rules with great clarity.
examples.zh: 老師把規則解釋得非常清楚。

examples.en: The new screen has amazing clarity, making small text easy to read.
examples.zh: 新螢幕的清晰度驚人，小字也很容易閱讀。

examples.en: The water in the lake has remarkable clarity.
examples.zh: 這座湖的湖水清澈得驚人。

examples.en: A clause usually has a subject and a verb.
examples.zh: 子句通常有主詞和動詞。

examples.en: Please read each clause of the contract carefully.
examples.zh: 請仔細閱讀合約的每一項條款。

examples.en: This clause says that the tenant must pay on time.
examples.zh: 這項條款規定房客必須準時繳費。

examples.en: The baby clung to her mother's arm at the airport.
examples.zh: 小嬰兒在機場緊抓著媽媽的手臂。

examples.en: Wet clothes cling to your skin on a rainy day.
examples.zh: 下雨天，濕衣服會緊貼在皮膚上。

examples.en: Some people cling to old habits even when they are unhelpful.
examples.zh: 即使舊習慣沒有幫助，有些人仍執著不放。

examples.en: The new medicine is now in its final clinical trial.
examples.zh: 這種新藥目前正在進行最後的臨床試驗。

examples.en: She is studying clinical psychology at a local university.
examples.zh: 她正在一所本地大學研讀臨床心理學。

examples.en: The manager gave a clinical review of the team's mistakes.
examples.zh: 經理冷靜客觀地檢討了團隊的失誤。

examples.en: A cluster of grapes hung from the vine.
examples.zh: 一串葡萄掛在藤上。

examples.en: There is a small cluster of shops near the station.
examples.zh: 車站附近有一小群商店。

examples.en: Astronomers found a cluster of stars far from Earth.
examples.zh: 天文學家發現了一群遠離地球的恆星。

examples.en: The children clustered around their teacher to hear the story.
examples.zh: 孩子們聚集在老師身邊聽故事。

examples.en: Tourists cluster near the entrance every morning.
examples.zh: 遊客每天早上都聚集在入口附近。

examples.en: Small houses cluster along the river.
examples.zh: 小房子沿著河岸聚集在一起。

examples.en: Cocaine is strictly controlled because of its health and addiction risks.
examples.zh: 古柯鹼因健康與成癮風險而受到嚴格管制。

examples.en: The health teacher explained how cocaine harms the heart.
examples.zh: 健康教育老師說明了古柯鹼如何傷害心臟。

examples.en: Customs officers are trained to find cocaine in luggage.
examples.zh: 海關人員受過訓練，能在行李中找出古柯鹼。

examples.en: The family stood quietly beside the coffin.
examples.zh: 家人安靜地站在棺木旁。

examples.en: The coffin was covered with white flowers.
examples.zh: 棺材上覆蓋著白色的花。

examples.en: Six relatives carried the coffin into the church.
examples.zh: 六位親戚把靈柩抬進教堂。

examples.en: Her essay was clear and coherent from start to finish.
examples.zh: 她的文章從頭到尾清楚而連貫。

examples.en: The witness gave a coherent account of the accident.
examples.zh: 目擊者條理分明地說明了事故經過。

examples.en: We need a coherent plan for the school festival.
examples.zh: 我們需要一份連貫而有條理的校園慶典計畫。

examples.en: The project was a collaboration between two schools.
examples.zh: 這個專案是兩所學校合作的成果。

examples.en: Close collaboration helped the team finish ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 密切的合作讓團隊提前完成工作。

examples.en: The book is a collaboration between a writer and an artist.
examples.zh: 這本書是一位作家與一位畫家合著的作品。

examples.en: The villagers made a collective decision to build a new school.
examples.zh: 村民們共同決定要蓋一所新學校。

examples.en: It was a collective effort by the whole class.
examples.zh: 那是全班共同努力的成果。

examples.en: All team members share collective responsibility for the success of the project.
examples.zh: 所有團隊成員都對專案的成功負有共同責任。

examples.en: The farmers formed a collective to sell their rice.
examples.zh: 農民們組成合作社來銷售稻米。

examples.en: She works at a small art collective downtown.
examples.zh: 她在市區一個小型藝術團體工作。

examples.en: The collective shares all its tools and profits.
examples.zh: 這個合作社共用所有的工具與利潤。

examples.en: My uncle is a stamp collector with thousands of stamps.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是集郵家，擁有數千張郵票。

examples.en: The collector paid a high price for the old painting.
examples.zh: 這位收藏家為那幅古畫付出了高價。

examples.en: A ticket collector walked through the train car.
examples.zh: 一位收票員走過車廂。

examples.en: The museum has many items from the colonial period.
examples.zh: 博物館收藏了許多殖民時期的物品。

examples.en: Colonial rulers once controlled much of the island.
examples.zh: 殖民統治者曾經控制島上大部分地區。

examples.en: We visited an old colonial building in the city center.
examples.zh: 我們參觀了市中心一棟殖民時期的老建築。

examples.en: The columnist writes about food for a local newspaper.
examples.zh: 這位專欄作家為一家地方報紙撰寫飲食專欄。

examples.en: My mother never misses the columnist's weekend article.
examples.zh: 我媽媽從不錯過那位專欄作家的週末文章。

examples.en: The columnist shared her opinion on public transportation.
examples.zh: 這位專欄作家分享了她對大眾運輸的看法。

examples.en: The soldier trained for months before he entered combat.
examples.zh: 那位士兵訓練了好幾個月才上戰場。

examples.en: The film is about a young pilot in aerial combat.
examples.zh: 這部電影是關於一位年輕飛行員的空戰故事。

examples.en: He studied the history of ancient combat in class.
examples.zh: 他在課堂上研讀古代作戰的歷史。

examples.en: The city plans to combat air pollution this year.
examples.zh: 這座城市計畫今年對抗空氣汙染。

examples.en: Doctors are working hard to combat the disease.
examples.zh: 醫生們正努力防治這種疾病。

examples.en: Regular exercise can help combat stress and improve our mood.
examples.zh: 規律運動有助於對抗壓力，並改善我們的心情。

examples.en: The radio commentary made the game easy to follow.
examples.zh: 廣播的實況報導讓人很容易跟上比賽。

examples.en: Her commentary on the novel was clear and thoughtful.
examples.zh: 她對這本小說的評論清楚而有見地。

examples.en: The newspaper printed a short commentary on the new law.
examples.zh: 報紙刊登了一篇針對新法律的短評。

examples.en: The sports commentator shouted when the team scored.
examples.zh: 球隊得分時，體育播報員大聲喊叫。

examples.en: A political commentator joined the evening news program.
examples.zh: 一位政治評論員參與了晚間新聞節目。

examples.en: My dad enjoys listening to the baseball commentator.
examples.zh: 我爸爸喜歡聽棒球播報員的轉播。

senses.zh: 商品（尤指原物料）；有價值的事物

examples.en: Rice is an important commodity in many Asian countries.
examples.zh: 稻米在許多亞洲國家是重要的商品。

examples.en: The price of this commodity rose sharply last month.
examples.zh: 這項商品的價格上個月大幅上漲。

examples.en: Clean water is a precious commodity in the desert.
examples.zh: 在沙漠中，乾淨的水是珍貴的物資。

examples.en: Our history teacher explained the idea of communism.
examples.zh: 我們的歷史老師說明了共產主義的概念。

examples.en: Communism was a major topic in the twentieth century.
examples.zh: 共產主義是二十世紀的重要議題。

examples.en: The book compares communism with other economic systems.
examples.zh: 這本書把共產主義與其他經濟制度做了比較。

examples.en: She commutes to work by MRT every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早上搭捷運通勤上班。

examples.en: Many people commute from the suburbs into the city.
examples.zh: 許多人從郊區通勤進城。

examples.en: I commute about an hour each way.
examples.zh: 我單程通勤大約要一小時。

examples.en: My commute takes forty minutes by bus.
examples.zh: 我搭公車通勤要四十分鐘。

examples.en: A long commute can make people very tired.
examples.zh: 通勤時間長會讓人很疲累。

examples.en: He listens to podcasts during his commute.
examples.zh: 他在通勤途中收聽網路音訊節目。

examples.en: Thousands of commuters use this station every day.
examples.zh: 每天有數千名通勤者使用這個車站。

examples.en: The commuter train was crowded this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上的通勤列車很擁擠。

examples.en: Commuters complained about the delay after waiting on the platform for an hour.
examples.zh: 通勤者在月台等了一小時後，對誤點提出抱怨。

examples.en: This compact camera fits easily into my pocket.
examples.zh: 這台小巧的相機可以輕鬆放進我的口袋。

examples.en: They live in a compact apartment near the station.
examples.zh: 他們住在車站附近一間小巧的公寓。

examples.en: The compact design saves a lot of space.
examples.zh: 這種緊湊的設計節省了很多空間。

examples.en: She bought a compact for city driving.
examples.zh: 她買了一輛小型汽車在市區開。

examples.en: My grandmother keeps a powder compact in her purse.
examples.zh: 我奶奶的皮包裡放著一個粉盒。

examples.en: The rental company has a compact available this weekend.
examples.zh: 租車公司這個週末有一輛小型車可租。

examples.en: The two phones have comparable prices and features.
examples.zh: 這兩支手機的價格和功能相當。

examples.en: Her skills are comparable to those of a professional.
examples.zh: 她的技巧足以和專業人士相比。

examples.en: It is hard to find a comparable job in this town.
examples.zh: 在這個小鎮很難找到條件相當的工作。

examples.en: The nurse treated every patient with compassion.
examples.zh: 那位護理師以同情心對待每位病患。

examples.en: He felt great compassion for the lost child.
examples.zh: 他對那個走失的孩子深感憐憫。

examples.en: Teachers should show compassion to students in trouble.
examples.zh: 老師應該對遇到困難的學生展現慈悲心。

examples.en: She is a kind and compassionate doctor.
examples.zh: 她是一位親切又有同情心的醫生。

examples.en: The compassionate neighbor brought soup to the sick man.
examples.zh: 那位富有同情心的鄰居帶了湯給生病的男士。

examples.en: We need a more compassionate approach to this problem.
examples.zh: 我們需要用更有同情心的方式處理這個問題。

examples.en: This printer is compatible with both laptops and phones.
examples.zh: 這台印表機與筆記型電腦和手機都相容。

examples.en: They are very compatible and rarely argue.
examples.zh: 他們非常合得來，很少吵架。

examples.en: The new software is not compatible with my old computer.
examples.zh: 這套新軟體與我的舊電腦不相容。

examples.en: Heavy rain compelled us to cancel the picnic.
examples.zh: 大雨迫使我們取消了野餐。

examples.en: The law compels drivers to wear seat belts.
examples.zh: 法律規定駕駛人必須繫安全帶。

examples.en: She felt compelled to tell the truth.
examples.zh: 她覺得自己不得不說出實話。

examples.en: The airline will compensate passengers for the long delay.
examples.zh: 航空公司將為長時間的延誤補償乘客。

examples.en: Extra practice can compensate for a lack of talent.
examples.zh: 額外的練習可以彌補天分的不足。

examples.en: The company compensated him for the damaged laptop.
examples.zh: 公司就受損的筆記型電腦賠償了他。

examples.en: He received compensation for the damage to his car.
examples.zh: 他的車子受損，因此獲得了賠償金。

examples.en: The company offers fair compensation for overtime work.
examples.zh: 公司為加班提供合理的報酬。

examples.en: Workers asked for compensation after the factory closed.
examples.zh: 工廠關閉後，員工要求補償。

examples.en: Her competence in math impressed the whole class.
examples.zh: 她的數學能力讓全班印象深刻。

examples.en: The manager praised his competence and hard work.
examples.zh: 經理稱讚他的能力與努力。

examples.en: Doubts about her competence disappeared after she successfully managed the difficult project.
examples.zh: 她成功管理那項棘手的專案後，對她能力的疑慮便消除了。

examples.en: He is a competent driver with ten years of experience.
examples.zh: 他是一位有十年經驗的稱職駕駛。

examples.en: We are looking for a competent assistant.
examples.zh: 我們正在尋找一位有能力的助理。

examples.en: The students are competent in basic English.
examples.zh: 這些學生具備基本的英語能力。

examples.en: The complexity of the rules confused many players.
examples.zh: 規則的複雜讓許多玩家感到困惑。

examples.en: Teachers should adjust the complexity of the lesson for beginners.
examples.zh: 老師應該為初學者調整課程的複雜程度。

examples.en: She was surprised by the complexity of the machine.
examples.zh: 她對這台機器的複雜程度感到驚訝。

examples.en: The surgery went well without any complication.
examples.zh: 手術很順利，沒有任何併發症。

examples.en: A sudden storm added a complication to our trip.
examples.zh: 突如其來的暴風雨為我們的旅程增添了麻煩。

examples.en: The new rule only created more complications.
examples.zh: 這項新規定只造成了更多的麻煩。

examples.en: All visitors must comply with the safety rules.
examples.zh: 所有訪客都必須遵守安全規定。

examples.en: The company agreed to comply with the new law.
examples.zh: 公司同意遵守新法律。

examples.en: Drivers who do not comply may have to pay a fine.
examples.zh: 不遵守規定的駕駛人可能要繳罰款。

examples.en: The factory makes components for electric cars.
examples.zh: 這間工廠生產電動車的零件。

examples.en: Exercise is an important component of a healthy life.
examples.zh: 運動是健康生活的重要組成部分。

examples.en: Each component of the machine was checked carefully.
examples.zh: 機器的每個零件都經過仔細檢查。

examples.en: Young children cannot always comprehend complex ideas.
examples.zh: 年幼的孩子不一定能理解複雜的概念。

examples.en: I could not comprehend the instructions in the manual.
examples.zh: 我看不懂說明書上的指示。

examples.en: It is hard to comprehend how big the universe is.
examples.zh: 很難理解宇宙究竟有多大。
