examples.en: The committee comprises five teachers and three parents.
examples.zh: 委員會由五位老師和三位家長組成。

examples.en: The test comprises two parts: listening and reading.
examples.zh: 這項測驗包含兩個部分：聽力與閱讀。

examples.en: Girls comprise about half of the swimming club.
examples.zh: 女孩約占游泳社的一半。

examples.en: After a long talk, the two sides reached a compromise.
examples.zh: 經過長時間討論，雙方達成了妥協。

examples.en: A compromise is often better than a quarrel.
examples.zh: 折衷方案往往比爭吵更好。

examples.en: Our compromise was to eat out on Fridays.
examples.zh: 我們的折衷辦法是每週五外食。

examples.en: Both sides must compromise to end the dispute.
examples.zh: 雙方必須妥協才能結束爭議。

examples.en: I will not compromise on the quality of our products.
examples.zh: 我不會在產品品質上讓步。

examples.en: Using weak passwords can compromise your safety.
examples.zh: 使用過於簡單的密碼可能危及你的安全。

examples.en: English is a compulsory subject in junior high school.
examples.zh: 英文是國中的必修科目。

examples.en: Wearing a helmet is compulsory for all riders.
examples.zh: 所有騎士都必須戴安全帽。

examples.en: Attendance at the training meeting is compulsory for all new employees.
examples.zh: 所有新進員工都必須出席這場訓練會議。

examples.en: He finally conceded that he had made a mistake.
examples.zh: 他終於承認自己犯了錯。

examples.en: The team conceded two goals in the first half.
examples.zh: 這支球隊上半場失了兩球。

examples.en: The coach conceded defeat after the final whistle ended the match.
examples.zh: 終場哨聲響起、比賽結束後，教練承認落敗。

examples.en: The engineer conceived a new way to save energy.
examples.zh: 工程師構想出一種節約能源的新方法。

examples.en: I cannot conceive of living without music.
examples.zh: 我無法想像沒有音樂的生活。

examples.en: They tried for years to conceive a child.
examples.zh: 他們多年來一直嘗試懷孕。

examples.en: Many students have a wrong conception of the test.
examples.zh: 許多學生對這項測驗有錯誤的觀念。

examples.en: The doctor answered the couple's questions about conception and early pregnancy.
examples.zh: 醫師回答了這對伴侶關於受孕與懷孕初期的問題。

examples.en: The conception of the new park took two years.
examples.zh: 這座新公園的構想花了兩年才成形。

senses.zh: 譴責；判刑；宣告不宜使用

examples.en: Leaders around the world condemned the attack.
examples.zh: 世界各國領袖都譴責了那起攻擊。

examples.en: The court condemned the criminal to ten years in prison.
examples.zh: 法院判處那名罪犯十年徒刑。

examples.en: The old bridge was condemned as unsafe.
examples.zh: 那座老橋被宣告不安全而禁止使用。

senses.zh: 坦白（承認過錯或秘密）；告解（宗教）

examples.en: His confession surprised everyone in the office.
examples.zh: 他的坦承讓辦公室裡的每個人都很驚訝。

examples.en: She made a confession about breaking the vase.
examples.zh: 她坦白承認打破了花瓶。

examples.en: The priest heard his confession and offered words of comfort.
examples.zh: 神父聽了他的告解，並說了幾句安慰的話。

examples.en: Please keep this information strictly confidential until the company makes an official announcement.
examples.zh: 在公司正式公告之前，請將這項資訊嚴格保密。

examples.en: The report is marked confidential and cannot be shared.
examples.zh: 這份報告標示為機密，不能外流。

examples.en: The hospital keeps all patients' records strictly confidential.
examples.zh: 醫院對所有病患的紀錄都嚴格保密。

examples.en: All new buildings must conform to safety standards.
examples.zh: 所有新建築都必須符合安全標準。

examples.en: Students are asked to conform to the school dress code.
examples.zh: 學生被要求遵守學校的服裝規定。

examples.en: She refused to conform to what others expected.
examples.zh: 她不肯順從別人的期待。

examples.en: Our team won five consecutive games before losing in the final.
examples.zh: 我們的球隊連贏五場後，在決賽落敗。

examples.en: It rained for three consecutive days, causing several roads to flood.
examples.zh: 連續下了三天的雨，造成幾條道路淹水。

examples.en: She was late for the second consecutive week.
examples.zh: 她已經連續第二週遲到了。

examples.en: The class reached a consensus on the trip.
examples.zh: 全班對旅行的事達成了共識。

examples.en: There is no consensus on the best solution.
examples.zh: 對於最佳解決方案尚無共識。

examples.en: The committee worked hard to build a consensus.
examples.zh: 委員會努力建立共識。

examples.en: Students need their parents' consent to join the trip.
examples.zh: 學生需要家長同意才能參加旅行。

examples.en: He gave his consent to the plan.
examples.zh: 他同意了這項計畫。

examples.en: The doctor asked for her written consent.
examples.zh: 醫生請她提供書面同意書。

examples.en: My parents finally consented to my study abroad plan.
examples.zh: 我父母終於同意我出國讀書的計畫。

examples.en: She consented to an interview with the school paper.
examples.zh: 她答應接受校刊的訪問。

examples.en: He would not consent to sell the house.
examples.zh: 他不肯同意賣掉房子。

examples.en: The park focuses on wildlife conservation by protecting habitats and limiting development.
examples.zh: 這座公園透過保護棲地並限制開發，著重推動野生動物保育。

examples.en: Water conservation is important during dry summers.
examples.zh: 在乾燥的夏季，節約用水很重要。

examples.en: Experts are working on the conservation of old paintings.
examples.zh: 專家們正在進行古畫的保存工作。

examples.en: Freedom of speech is a constitutional right.
examples.zh: 言論自由是憲法賦予的權利。

examples.en: The court will decide whether the law is constitutional.
examples.zh: 法院將判定這項法律是否合憲。

examples.en: They discussed a constitutional change in class.
examples.zh: 他們在課堂上討論了憲法修正案。

examples.en: Time is our biggest constraint on this project.
examples.zh: 時間是這個專案最大的限制。

examples.en: Budget constraints forced the school to cancel the trip.
examples.zh: 預算的限制迫使學校取消了旅行。

examples.en: She felt no constraint when talking to her friends.
examples.zh: 她和朋友聊天時感覺不到拘束。

examples.en: You can book a free consultation with the advisor.
examples.zh: 你可以預約顧問的免費諮詢。

examples.en: After consultation with her parents, she chose a college.
examples.zh: 與父母商量之後，她選定了一所大學。

examples.en: The doctor's consultation lasted about twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 醫生的看診大約持續了二十分鐘。

senses.zh: 消耗；消費；攝取（食物或飲料）

examples.en: The city wants to reduce its energy consumption.
examples.zh: 這座城市希望降低能源消耗。

examples.en: Frequent consumption of sugary drinks is bad for your teeth.
examples.zh: 經常飲用含糖飲料對牙齒不好。

examples.en: Rising consumption helped the shops make more money.
examples.zh: 消費增加使商店賺到更多錢。

senses.zh: 有傳染性的；有感染力的

examples.en: The flu is highly contagious, so stay home if you feel sick.
examples.zh: 流感的傳染力很強，所以如果你覺得不舒服就待在家裡。

examples.en: Her laughter was so contagious that everyone in the room joined in.
examples.zh: 她的笑聲很有感染力，讓房間裡的每個人都跟著笑了。

examples.en: The school sent a notice about a contagious skin disease.
examples.zh: 學校發了一份關於傳染性皮膚病的通知。

examples.en: Waste from the factory began to contaminate the river.
examples.zh: 工廠排出的廢棄物開始汙染這條河。

examples.en: Wash your hands so you do not contaminate the food.
examples.zh: 請洗手，以免汙染食物。

examples.en: Chemicals can contaminate the soil near the old farm.
examples.zh: 化學物質可能會汙染舊農場附近的土壤。

examples.en: He sat by the window to contemplate his future.
examples.zh: 他坐在窗邊思考自己的未來。

examples.en: She is contemplating moving to a smaller apartment.
examples.zh: 她正在考慮搬到較小的公寓。

examples.en: We contemplated taking the train, but it was too expensive.
examples.zh: 我們原本考慮搭火車，但費用太高了。

examples.en: He looked at the cheater with contempt.
examples.zh: 他輕蔑地看著那個作弊的人。

examples.en: The coach felt only contempt for players who gave up easily.
examples.zh: 教練對那些輕易放棄的球員只感到輕蔑。

examples.en: Her voice was full of contempt when she answered the question.
examples.zh: 她回答問題時，語氣中充滿了輕蔑。

examples.en: Three teams contend for the championship this year.
examples.zh: 今年有三支隊伍在爭奪冠軍。

examples.en: Some scientists contend that sleep improves memory.
examples.zh: 有些科學家主張睡眠能增進記憶。

examples.en: She had to contend with heavy traffic on her way to work.
examples.zh: 她在上班途中得應付嚴重的塞車。

examples.en: The contractor promised to finish the kitchen by June.
examples.zh: 承包商答應六月前完成廚房的工程。

examples.en: We hired a contractor to repair the roof.
examples.zh: 我們請了一位承包商來修屋頂。

examples.en: She works as an independent contractor for a software company.
examples.zh: 她以獨立承攬人的身分，為一家軟體公司提供服務。

examples.en: There is a clear contradiction between his words and his actions.
examples.zh: 他的言語和行為之間有明顯的矛盾。

examples.en: The report is full of contradictions, so I do not trust it.
examples.zh: 這份報告充滿矛盾，所以我不相信它。

examples.en: His claim that the door was both locked and unlocked contained an obvious contradiction.
examples.zh: 他聲稱門同時鎖著又沒鎖，這說法有明顯的矛盾。

examples.en: The mayor made a controversial decision about the new bridge.
examples.zh: 市長對這座新橋做了一個有爭議的決定。

examples.en: It is a controversial topic, so let's discuss it politely.
examples.zh: 這是個有爭議的話題，所以我們要禮貌地討論。

examples.en: The film was controversial because of its unusual ending.
examples.zh: 這部電影因為結局特殊而引起爭議。

examples.en: The new school rule caused a lot of controversy among parents.
examples.zh: 新的校規在家長之間引起很多爭議。

examples.en: There is still controversy over how to use the money.
examples.zh: 關於這筆錢該怎麼使用，仍然有爭議。

examples.en: The controversy ended after the company apologized.
examples.zh: 公司道歉之後，爭議就平息了。

examples.en: The conversion of the old factory into a mall took two years.
examples.zh: 把舊工廠改建成購物中心花了兩年。

examples.en: Use this chart for the conversion of miles to kilometers.
examples.zh: 請用這張表把英里換算成公里。

examples.en: The conversion to solar energy will lower our bills.
examples.zh: 改用太陽能會降低我們的帳單金額。

examples.en: We plan to convert the garage into a study room.
examples.zh: 我們打算把車庫改成書房。

examples.en: Please convert this file to PDF before you send it.
examples.zh: 寄出之前，請先把這個檔案轉成 PDF。

examples.en: You can convert dollars to euros at the airport.
examples.zh: 你可以在機場把美元換成歐元。

examples.en: The jury convicted the man of stealing the car.
examples.zh: 陪審團判定這名男子偷車有罪。

examples.en: He was convicted of fraud and had to pay a fine.
examples.zh: 他被判詐欺罪，必須繳交罰款。

examples.en: Without enough proof, the court could not convict her.
examples.zh: 由於證據不足，法院無法判她有罪。

examples.en: She spoke with great conviction at the meeting.
examples.zh: 她在會議上說話時充滿堅定的信念。

examples.en: His conviction that hard work pays off never changed.
examples.zh: 他堅信努力會有回報，這個信念從未改變。

examples.en: The man's conviction for fraud was in the news.
examples.zh: 那名男子被判詐欺罪的消息上了新聞。

examples.en: She coordinates volunteers for the school festival.
examples.zh: 她負責協調學校園遊會的志工。

examples.en: We need to coordinate our schedules before the trip.
examples.zh: 出發旅行前，我們得先協調彼此的行程。

examples.en: The teacher helped the students coordinate their group project.
examples.zh: 老師協助學生統籌他們的小組專案。

examples.en: Enter the coordinates of the hotel into your phone.
examples.zh: 把飯店的座標輸入你的手機。

examples.en: The map shows the coordinates of each city.
examples.zh: 這張地圖標示出每個城市的座標。

examples.en: Find the coordinates of point A on the graph.
examples.zh: 請在圖上找出 A 點的座標。

examples.en: The book is protected by copyright in many countries.
examples.zh: 這本書在許多國家受到著作權保護。

examples.en: Who owns the copyright to this song?
examples.zh: 這首歌的版權屬於誰？

examples.en: You must ask for permission before using photos under copyright.
examples.zh: 使用受版權保護的照片之前，必須先徵得同意。

examples.en: Please remove the core before slicing the apple.
examples.zh: 切蘋果之前，請先把果核去掉。

examples.en: Honesty is at the core of our school values.
examples.zh: 誠實是我們學校價值觀的核心。

examples.en: The earth has a very hot core.
examples.zh: 地球有一個非常熱的核心。

examples.en: Math is a core subject in every school.
examples.zh: 數學是每所學校的核心科目。

examples.en: Teamwork is a core value of our company.
examples.zh: 團隊合作是我們公司的核心價值。

examples.en: The core members of the club meet every Friday.
examples.zh: 社團的核心成員每週五見面。

examples.en: She works in the corporate office downtown.
examples.zh: 她在市區的公司總部上班。

examples.en: The company holds a corporate event every spring.
examples.zh: 這家公司每年春天都會舉辦一次企業活動。

examples.en: Many corporate employees wear suits to work.
examples.zh: 許多企業員工穿西裝上班。

examples.en: Studies show a strong correlation between sleep and grades.
examples.zh: 研究顯示睡眠和成績之間有很強的相關性。

examples.en: There is no clear correlation between price and quality here.
examples.zh: 在這裡，價格和品質之間沒有明顯的關聯。

examples.en: The teacher explained the correlation between exercise and health.
examples.zh: 老師說明了運動和健康之間的關聯。

examples.en: The corrupt official took money from local businesses.
examples.zh: 那位貪汙的官員向當地商家收錢。

examples.en: Many people lost trust in the corrupt system.
examples.zh: 許多人對這個腐敗的制度失去了信任。

examples.en: A corrupt file cannot be opened by the program.
examples.zh: 程式無法開啟已損毀的檔案。

examples.en: Too much power can corrupt even honest people.
examples.zh: 權力太大，連誠實的人也可能變壞。

examples.en: Bad friends may corrupt a young child.
examples.zh: 壞朋友可能會讓年幼的孩子變壞。

examples.en: A virus can corrupt the data on your computer.
examples.zh: 病毒可能會損毀你電腦裡的資料。

examples.en: The mayor was removed from office because of corruption.
examples.zh: 市長因為貪汙而被免職。

examples.en: The new law is meant to fight corruption.
examples.zh: 這項新法律的目的是打擊貪汙。

examples.en: Data corruption caused the game to crash during loading.
examples.zh: 資料損毀導致遊戲在載入時當機。

examples.en: She gave the young man wise counsel.
examples.zh: 她給了那位年輕人明智的忠告。

examples.en: The company's legal counsel reviewed the contract.
examples.zh: 公司的法律顧問審閱了合約。

examples.en: He sought counsel from his teacher before choosing a major.
examples.zh: 他在選擇主修之前向老師請教。

examples.en: Doctors counsel patients to eat less salt.
examples.zh: 醫生建議病人少吃鹽。

examples.en: I would counsel you to wait until tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我建議你等到明天。

examples.en: The school counselor counsels students who feel anxious about exams.
examples.zh: 學校輔導老師會輔導對考試感到焦慮的學生。

senses.zh: 輔導老師；營隊輔導員；諮商師

examples.en: The school counselor helped me choose a college.
examples.zh: 學校輔導老師幫我選擇大學。

examples.en: A summer camp counselor led the kids on a hike.
examples.zh: 一位夏令營輔導員帶孩子們去健行。

examples.en: She sees a counselor every week to talk about stress.
examples.zh: 她每週都會找諮商師談談壓力。

senses.zh: 報導；訊號涵蓋範圍；保險保障範圍

examples.en: The news gave full coverage of the festival.
examples.zh: 新聞對這場慶典做了完整的報導。

examples.en: My phone has poor coverage in the mountains.
examples.zh: 我的手機在山區收訊不佳。

examples.en: This insurance plan includes coverage for dental care.
examples.zh: 這個保險方案包含牙科的保障。

examples.en: The reporter lost credibility after the false story.
examples.zh: 那位記者在假新聞事件之後失去了可信度。

examples.en: A clear source adds credibility to your essay.
examples.zh: 清楚的資料來源能增加你文章的可信度。

examples.en: Many students question the credibility of that website.
examples.zh: 許多學生質疑那個網站的可信度。

examples.en: The kids caught tadpoles in the creek.
examples.zh: 孩子們在小溪裡抓蝌蚪。

examples.en: A small creek runs behind our house.
examples.zh: 我們家後面有一條小溪流過。

examples.en: We crossed the creek on a wooden bridge.
examples.zh: 我們走過一座木橋，越過小溪。

examples.en: The main criterion for the job is good communication.
examples.zh: 這份工作的主要條件是良好的溝通能力。

examples.en: Price is the only criterion she uses when shopping.
examples.zh: 價格是她購物時唯一的考量標準。

examples.en: Each criterion on the list must be met.
examples.zh: 清單上的每一項標準都必須達成。

examples.en: Sleep is crucial for students before an exam.
examples.zh: 考試前，睡眠對學生來說非常重要。

examples.en: Your help was crucial to our success.
examples.zh: 你的幫忙對我們的成功至關重要。

examples.en: It is crucial to read the instructions first.
examples.zh: 先閱讀說明書是非常重要的。

senses.zh: 粗略的；粗俗的；未加工的

examples.en: The boy drew a crude map of the village.
examples.zh: 男孩畫了一張粗略的村莊地圖。

examples.en: His crude jokes made the guests uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 他粗俗的笑話讓客人們很不自在。

examples.en: Crude oil must be refined before it can be used.
examples.zh: 原油必須先經過提煉才能使用。

examples.en: We took a cruise to Japan last summer.
examples.zh: 我們去年夏天搭郵輪去了日本。

examples.en: The cruise was relaxing, with good food and music.
examples.zh: 這趟郵輪旅行很放鬆，有美食和音樂。

examples.en: Her parents are planning a cruise around the Mediterranean.
examples.zh: 她的父母正在規劃一趟環地中海的郵輪旅行。

examples.en: The ship will cruise along the coast for three days.
examples.zh: 這艘船將沿著海岸航行三天。

examples.en: Cars cruise down the main street on weekends.
examples.zh: 週末時，車子會在大街上平穩地行駛。

examples.en: The plane cruises at a high altitude.
examples.zh: 飛機在高空平穩飛行。

examples.en: Taiwanese cuisine is popular with tourists from around the world.
examples.zh: 台灣料理很受來自世界各地的觀光客歡迎。

examples.en: This restaurant serves traditional Italian cuisine made with fresh ingredients.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳供應以新鮮食材製作的傳統義式料理。

examples.en: She learned about French cuisine in cooking class.
examples.zh: 她在烹飪課上認識了法式料理。

examples.en: What is the local currency in Japan?
examples.zh: 日本當地使用的貨幣是什麼？

examples.en: You can exchange foreign currency at the airport.
examples.zh: 你可以在機場兌換外幣。

examples.en: The online store accepts payment in a digital currency.
examples.zh: 這家網路商店接受以數位貨幣付款。

examples.en: The school added coding to its curriculum.
examples.zh: 學校把程式設計加進了課程。

examples.en: The curriculum includes math, science, and art.
examples.zh: 課程包含數學、科學和美術。

examples.en: Teachers help design the curriculum each year.
examples.zh: 老師們每年都會協助設計課程。

examples.en: After the divorce, the mother got custody of the children.
examples.zh: 離婚後，母親取得孩子的監護權。

examples.en: The suspect remained in police custody overnight after the arrest.
examples.zh: 嫌犯被捕後由警方拘留過夜。

examples.en: The package stayed in the custody of the post office.
examples.zh: 包裹由郵局保管。

examples.en: This snake's bite is deadly to humans.
examples.zh: 這種蛇的咬傷對人類是致命的。

examples.en: Smoking can cause deadly diseases that damage the heart and lungs.
examples.zh: 吸菸可能引發損害心臟和肺部的致命疾病。

examples.en: The storm was deadly for the farmers' crops.
examples.zh: 這場暴風雨對農民的作物來說是毀滅性的。

examples.en: Workers cleared the debris after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨後，工人清除了殘骸。

examples.en: Debris from the old building fell onto the sidewalk.
examples.zh: 舊大樓的碎片掉到了人行道上。

examples.en: Space debris can damage satellites when it collides with them.
examples.zh: 太空垃圾與衛星相撞時，可能使衛星受損。

examples.en: The singer made her debut at the age of sixteen.
examples.zh: 那位歌手十六歲就初次登台。

examples.en: The new phone will make its debut next month.
examples.zh: 這支新手機下個月將首度亮相。

examples.en: His debut album sold very well in several countries.
examples.zh: 他的首張專輯在好幾個國家都賣得非常好。

examples.en: He earns a decent salary at the bank.
examples.zh: 他在銀行賺取不錯的薪水。

examples.en: We found a decent hotel near the station.
examples.zh: 我們在車站附近找到一間不錯的旅館。

examples.en: Please wear decent clothes to the interview.
examples.zh: 請穿著得體的衣服去面試。

examples.en: She dedicated her life to helping children.
examples.zh: 她一生致力於幫助孩子。

examples.en: He dedicated the song to his mother.
examples.zh: 他把這首歌獻給他的母親。

examples.en: We dedicate every Sunday to cleaning the house.
examples.zh: 我們把每個星期天都用來打掃家裡。

examples.en: The defendant said he was not guilty.
examples.zh: 被告說他沒有罪。

examples.en: The judge asked the defendant to stand.
examples.zh: 法官請被告起立。

examples.en: A lawyer spoke for the defendant in court.
examples.zh: 一位律師在法庭上為被告發言。

examples.en: Teenagers sometimes defy their parents' rules to gain more independence.
examples.zh: 青少年有時會為了爭取更多自主而違抗父母訂的規矩。

examples.en: The old man defied the doctor's advice and went hiking.
examples.zh: 那位老先生不顧醫生的建議去健行。

examples.en: She defied the ban and rode her bike to school.
examples.zh: 她違抗禁令，騎腳踏車去學校。

examples.en: A Japanese delegation visited our school to discuss student exchanges.
examples.zh: 一個日本代表團參訪了我們學校，討論學生交流事宜。

examples.en: The delegation arrived at the airport this morning.
examples.zh: 代表團今天早上抵達機場。

examples.en: Good managers are skilled at delegation and trust their teams.
examples.zh: 優秀的主管擅長授權，也信任自己的團隊。

examples.en: It was a deliberate choice to move abroad.
examples.zh: 搬到國外是經過審慎考慮的選擇。

examples.en: She took a deliberate step across the ice.
examples.zh: 她小心翼翼地踏過冰面。

examples.en: The mistake was not deliberate, so she quickly apologized.
examples.zh: 這個錯誤不是故意的，所以她很快就道歉了。

examples.en: The committee will deliberate for several days.
examples.zh: 委員會將審議好幾天。

examples.en: We deliberated over where to hold the party.
examples.zh: 我們仔細討論派對要在哪裡舉辦。

examples.en: The jury needs time to deliberate before reaching a verdict.
examples.zh: 陪審團需要時間審議，才能作出裁決。

examples.en: His denial surprised everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 他的否認讓房間裡的每個人都很驚訝。

examples.en: The company issued a denial of the rumor.
examples.zh: 公司發表聲明否認這項傳聞。

examples.en: The denial of her visa application upset her.
examples.zh: 簽證申請被拒絕讓她很難過。

examples.en: Taipei has a high population density compared with many smaller cities.
examples.zh: 相較於許多較小的城市，台北的人口密度很高。

examples.en: Water and oil have different densities, so oil floats on water.
examples.zh: 水和油的密度不同，因此油會浮在水面上。

examples.en: The density of the forest blocks the sunlight.
examples.zh: 森林的茂密擋住了陽光。

examples.en: The painting depicts a village by the sea.
examples.zh: 這幅畫描繪了一座海邊的村莊。

examples.en: The film depicts life in the 1960s.
examples.zh: 這部電影描寫了一九六○年代的生活。

examples.en: Children often depict their families in drawings.
examples.zh: 孩子常在畫中描繪他們的家人。

examples.en: The city will deploy more buses during the holidays.
examples.zh: 市政府將在假期期間調派更多公車。

examples.en: The company plans to deploy the new software next week.
examples.zh: 公司計畫下週部署這套新軟體。

examples.en: Rescue teams were deployed to the flooded area.
examples.zh: 救援隊被調派到淹水地區。

examples.en: Many common English words derive from Latin and Greek.
examples.zh: 許多常見的英文單字源自拉丁文和希臘文。

examples.en: She derives great joy from teaching young children to read.
examples.zh: 她從教年幼的孩子閱讀中獲得很大的快樂。

examples.en: This word is derived from a French term.
examples.zh: 這個字衍生自一個法文詞彙。

examples.en: The plane began to descend slowly as it approached the airport.
examples.zh: 飛機接近機場時，開始緩緩下降。

examples.en: We descended the stairs to the basement.
examples.zh: 我們走下樓梯到地下室。

examples.en: The path descends to a quiet beach.
examples.zh: 這條小徑往下通到一處安靜的海灘。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to write a descriptive essay.
examples.zh: 老師要我們寫一篇描寫文。

examples.en: Her descriptive language made the story easy to picture.
examples.zh: 她描寫生動的語言讓故事很容易想像。

examples.en: Use descriptive names for your files so others can find them easily.
examples.zh: 請替你的檔案取具說明性的名稱，讓別人能輕易找到檔案。

examples.en: He believed it was his destiny to become a doctor.
examples.zh: 他相信成為醫生是他的天命。

examples.en: She wants to take control of her own destiny.
examples.zh: 她想掌握自己的命運。

examples.en: Many people believe that love is a matter of destiny.
examples.zh: 許多人相信愛情是命中注定的。

senses.zh: 診斷；判斷出（問題的原因）

examples.en: The doctor diagnosed her with a mild case of the flu.
examples.zh: 醫生診斷她得了輕微的流感。

examples.en: It took the mechanic an hour to diagnose the problem with our car.
examples.zh: 技師花了一個小時才診斷出我們車子的問題。

examples.en: Early tests can help doctors diagnose the disease quickly.
examples.zh: 早期檢驗能幫助醫生快速診斷出這種疾病。

examples.en: The doctor gave a clear diagnosis after reading the test results.
examples.zh: 醫生看完檢驗報告後，做出了明確的診斷。

examples.en: An early diagnosis can make the treatment much easier.
examples.zh: 早期診斷能讓治療容易許多。

examples.en: The company hired an expert to make a diagnosis of its sales problems.
examples.zh: 公司請了一位專家來診斷銷售上的問題。

examples.en: The diameter of this pizza is about thirty centimeters.
examples.zh: 這個披薩的直徑大約是三十公分。

examples.en: Measure the diameter of the circle with a ruler.
examples.zh: 用尺量一下這個圓的直徑。

examples.en: The tree trunk has a diameter of nearly two meters.
examples.zh: 這棵樹的樹幹直徑將近兩公尺。

examples.en: The baby needs a clean diaper after her nap.
examples.zh: 寶寶午睡後需要換一片乾淨的尿布。

examples.en: We bought a large pack of diapers at the store.
examples.zh: 我們在店裡買了一大包尿布。

examples.en: My sister keeps an extra diaper in her bag.
examples.zh: 我姊姊的包包裡總是多放一片尿布。

examples.en: She faced a dilemma between a high salary and more free time.
examples.zh: 她面臨高薪與更多自由時間之間的兩難。

examples.en: The manager is in a dilemma over whom to promote.
examples.zh: 經理為了該升遷誰而陷入兩難。

examples.en: Students often face the dilemma of choosing between study and sleep.
examples.zh: 學生常面臨讀書與睡覺之間的兩難。

examples.en: What are the dimensions of this table?
examples.zh: 這張桌子的尺寸是多少？

examples.en: A cube has three dimensions: length, width and height.
examples.zh: 立方體有三個維度：長、寬、高。

examples.en: Social media has added a new dimension to how we make friends.
examples.zh: 社群媒體為我們交朋友的方式增添了新的層面。

examples.en: The pain began to diminish after she took the medicine.
examples.zh: 她吃了藥之後，疼痛開始減輕。

examples.en: Heavy traffic can diminish the pleasure of a short trip.
examples.zh: 嚴重的塞車可能會減損短途旅行的樂趣。

examples.en: His interest in the game diminished as the season went on.
examples.zh: 隨著球季進行，他對比賽的興趣逐漸減退。

examples.en: The two countries agreed to restore diplomatic relations.
examples.zh: 兩國同意恢復外交關係。

examples.en: She gave a diplomatic answer to avoid hurting his feelings.
examples.zh: 她給了一個圓滑的回答，以免傷了他的感情。

examples.en: The ambassador is on a diplomatic visit to Japan.
examples.zh: 大使正在日本進行外交訪問。

examples.en: You can find her number in the staff directory.
examples.zh: 你可以在員工通訊錄裡找到她的電話。

examples.en: Please save the file in the correct directory on your computer.
examples.zh: 請把檔案存到電腦中正確的資料夾裡。

examples.en: The directory at the entrance lists every shop in the mall.
examples.zh: 入口處的導覽目錄列出了購物中心裡的每一家店。

examples.en: The company refused to disclose the price of the deal.
examples.zh: 公司拒絕透露這筆交易的價格。

examples.en: Please do not disclose your password to anyone.
examples.zh: 請不要把你的密碼透露給任何人。

examples.en: The report disclosed that the school needed more funding.
examples.zh: 報告揭露了這所學校需要更多經費。

examples.en: It is against the law to discriminate against people because of their age.
examples.zh: 因為年齡而歧視他人是違法的。

examples.en: Young children can discriminate between different colors.
examples.zh: 年幼的孩子能分辨不同的顏色。

examples.en: The school does not discriminate on the basis of gender.
examples.zh: 這所學校不因性別而有差別待遇。

examples.en: The company has strict rules against discrimination at work.
examples.zh: 公司對職場歧視訂有嚴格的規定。

examples.en: Everyone should be treated fairly without discrimination.
examples.zh: 每個人都應該受到公平對待，不受歧視。

examples.en: The test measures visual discrimination between similar shapes and patterns.
examples.zh: 這項測驗衡量辨別相似形狀與圖案的視覺能力。

examples.en: Heavy rain disrupted train services this morning.
examples.zh: 大雨使今天早上的火車班次受到干擾。

examples.en: Please turn off your phone so you do not disrupt the class.
examples.zh: 請把手機關機，以免打擾上課。

examples.en: The sudden power cut disrupted our meeting.
examples.zh: 突然停電打斷了我們的會議。

examples.en: She has a distinctive laugh that everyone recognizes.
examples.zh: 她有一種大家都認得出來的獨特笑聲。

examples.en: The café is famous for its distinctive blue door.
examples.zh: 這家咖啡廳以它獨特的藍色大門聞名。

examples.en: This dish has a distinctive flavor that comes from fresh ginger.
examples.zh: 這道菜有一種來自新鮮薑的獨特風味。

examples.en: Loud music can distract students from their homework.
examples.zh: 大聲的音樂可能會讓學生寫功課時分心。

examples.en: Don't let your phone distract you while you are driving.
examples.zh: 開車時別讓手機使你分心。

examples.en: The teacher showed a picture to distract the crying child.
examples.zh: 老師拿出一張圖片來轉移那個哭泣孩子的注意力。

examples.en: The church teaches the doctrine of kindness and forgiveness.
examples.zh: 教會教導仁慈與寬恕的教義。

examples.en: Students learned about the main doctrine of the ancient philosopher.
examples.zh: 學生們學習了這位古代哲學家的主要學說。

examples.en: The party changed its doctrine after the election.
examples.zh: 該黨在選舉後修改了它的信條。

examples.en: We watched a documentary about ocean animals in class.
examples.zh: 我們在課堂上看了一部關於海洋動物的紀錄片。

examples.en: This documentary shows how bread is made in a small village.
examples.zh: 這部紀錄片介紹了小村莊裡麵包是如何製作的。

examples.en: My father enjoys documentaries on history and travel.
examples.zh: 我爸爸喜歡看歷史和旅遊的紀錄片。

examples.en: The museum has a documentary film about the old town.
examples.zh: 博物館有一部關於這座古城的紀實影片。

examples.en: She found documentary evidence in the old letters.
examples.zh: 她在舊信件中找到了文獻證據。

examples.en: The teacher showed a documentary series on climate change.
examples.zh: 老師播放了一部關於氣候變遷的紀實系列影片。

examples.en: Medicine is not my domain, so I cannot give advice.
examples.zh: 醫學不是我的專業領域，所以我無法給建議。

examples.en: You need to pay a yearly fee to keep your domain name.
examples.zh: 你必須每年付費才能保有你的網域名稱。

examples.en: The lake was once part of the king's domain.
examples.zh: 這座湖泊曾經是國王領地的一部分。

examples.en: The old church has a beautiful dome painted with stars.
examples.zh: 這座古老的教堂有一個畫著星星的美麗圓頂。

examples.en: Thousands of fans gathered in the dome to watch the game.
examples.zh: 數千名球迷聚集在巨蛋裡看比賽。

examples.en: Sunlight shone through the glass dome of the library.
examples.zh: 陽光透過圖書館的玻璃圓頂照了進來。

examples.en: The school received a large donation from a local company.
examples.zh: 學校收到一家當地公司的大額捐款。

examples.en: We made a small donation to the animal shelter.
examples.zh: 我們對動物收容所捐了一筆小額款項。

examples.en: Blood donation helps save many lives when hospitals need supplies.
examples.zh: 醫院需要血液供應時，捐血有助於挽救許多生命。

examples.en: The hospital is looking for a blood donor.
examples.zh: 醫院正在尋找捐血者。

examples.en: A generous donor gave money to build the new library.
examples.zh: 一位慷慨的捐款人出錢興建新圖書館。

examples.en: She signed up to be an organ donor.
examples.zh: 她登記成為器官捐贈者。

examples.en: A little boy was standing in the doorway waiting for his mother.
examples.zh: 一個小男孩站在門口等他的媽媽。

examples.en: Please do not block the doorway during the fire drill.
examples.zh: 消防演習時請不要擋住門口。

examples.en: The cat sat in the doorway and watched the rain.
examples.zh: 那隻貓坐在門口看著雨。

examples.en: Mix the flour and water to make a soft dough.
examples.zh: 把麵粉和水混合，做成柔軟的麵糰。

examples.en: Let the dough rest for an hour before you bake it.
examples.zh: 烘烤前先讓麵糰靜置一個小時。

examples.en: The children enjoyed rolling the dough into small balls.
examples.zh: 孩子們很喜歡把麵糰搓成小球。

examples.en: Our car is parked in the driveway.
examples.zh: 我們的車停在車道上。

examples.en: My dad cleaned the snow off the driveway this morning.
examples.zh: 我爸爸今天早上把車道上的雪清乾淨了。

examples.en: A long driveway leads to the farmhouse.
examples.zh: 一條長長的車道通往農舍。

examples.en: The oil spill caused serious ecological damage to the coast.
examples.zh: 漏油事件對海岸造成嚴重的生態破壞。

examples.en: Scientists are worried about the ecological balance of the lake.
examples.zh: 科學家擔心這座湖的生態平衡。

examples.en: The farm uses ecological methods to grow vegetables.
examples.zh: 這座農場使用生態友善的方法種植蔬菜。

examples.en: She is studying ecology at university to understand how forests function.
examples.zh: 她在大學裡修讀生態學，以了解森林如何運作。

examples.en: Pollution can harm the ecology of a river.
examples.zh: 污染可能會破壞河川的生態。

examples.en: The class took a trip to learn about wetland ecology.
examples.zh: 全班去校外教學，認識濕地生態。

examples.en: A healthy forest is a complex ecosystem.
examples.zh: 健康的森林是一個複雜的生態系統。

examples.en: Plastic waste is harming the ocean ecosystem.
examples.zh: 塑膠廢棄物正在傷害海洋生態系統。

examples.en: Every animal plays a role in the ecosystem.
examples.zh: 每種動物在生態系統中都扮演著一個角色。

examples.en: His success in the contest gave his ego a big boost.
examples.zh: 他在比賽中的成功大大增強了他的自尊心。

examples.en: A good leader does not let ego get in the way of teamwork.
examples.zh: 好的領導者不會讓自我意識妨礙團隊合作。

examples.en: She has a big ego and hates to admit her mistakes.
examples.zh: 她很自大，而且不喜歡承認自己的錯誤。

examples.en: Students over sixteen are eligible to apply for the program.
examples.zh: 年齡超過十六歲的學生有資格申請這項計畫。

examples.en: You are eligible for a discount if you show your student card.
examples.zh: 出示學生證就可以享有折扣。

examples.en: Only citizens who are eighteen or older are eligible to vote.
examples.zh: 只有年滿十八歲的公民才有資格投票。

examples.en: She gave an eloquent speech at the graduation ceremony.
examples.zh: 她在畢業典禮上發表了一場生動有力的演說。

examples.en: The lawyer was eloquent and easily won the crowd over.
examples.zh: 那位律師口才很好，輕易就贏得了群眾的支持。

examples.en: His eloquent letter moved everyone in the office.
examples.zh: 他那封動人的信打動了辦公室裡的每一個人。

examples.en: The little girl ran to embrace her grandmother.
examples.zh: 小女孩跑過去擁抱她的奶奶。

examples.en: Many schools now embrace new technology in the classroom.
examples.zh: 現在許多學校都在教室裡採用新科技。

examples.en: He decided to embrace the change and learn a new skill.
examples.zh: 他決定欣然接受改變，學習一項新技能。

examples.en: The two friends met in a warm embrace.
examples.zh: 兩位朋友以溫暖的擁抱相見。

examples.en: The baby fell asleep in her mother's embrace.
examples.zh: 寶寶在媽媽的懷抱裡睡著了。

examples.en: They said goodbye with a long embrace at the airport.
examples.zh: 他們在機場以一個長長的擁抱道別。

examples.en: The government wants to reduce carbon emissions from cars.
examples.zh: 政府想減少汽車的碳排放。

examples.en: This factory has strict limits on emissions.
examples.zh: 這間工廠對排放量有嚴格的限制。

examples.en: Electric buses produce no exhaust emissions while traveling on the road.
examples.zh: 電動公車在路上行駛時不會排放廢氣。

senses.zh: 公開支持；代言；背書簽名

examples.en: The famous player endorsed a new brand of sports shoes.
examples.zh: 那位知名球員為一個新的運動鞋品牌背書。

examples.en: The teachers all endorsed the plan for a longer lunch break.
examples.zh: 老師們都支持延長午休時間的計畫。

examples.en: Please endorse the check on the back before you cash it.
examples.zh: 兌現支票前，請先在背面簽名背書。

examples.en: The company is a separate legal entity from its owners.
examples.zh: 這家公司是與其所有人分開的法律實體。

examples.en: The museum is an independent entity with its own budget.
examples.zh: 這間博物館是擁有自己預算的獨立單位。

examples.en: Each city in the country is treated as a separate entity.
examples.zh: 這個國家的每個城市都被視為獨立的個體。

examples.en: The young entrepreneur started her own bakery at twenty-five.
examples.zh: 這位年輕的創業者在二十五歲時開了自己的烘焙坊。

examples.en: Many entrepreneurs work long hours when their business is new.
examples.zh: 許多創業者在事業剛起步時工時很長。

examples.en: The entrepreneur gave a talk to students about starting a company.
examples.zh: 那位企業家對學生演講，談如何創立公司。

examples.en: The flu epidemic closed several schools last winter.
examples.zh: 去年冬天流感大流行，導致好幾所學校停課。

examples.en: Doctors worked hard to stop the epidemic from spreading.
examples.zh: 醫生們努力防止這場疫情擴散。

examples.en: Obesity has become an epidemic in many countries.
examples.zh: 肥胖在許多國家已經成為普遍的問題。

examples.en: The disease reached epidemic levels in the city.
examples.zh: 這種疾病在這座城市已達到流行的程度。

examples.en: Health officials warned of epidemic flu this season.
examples.zh: 衛生官員警告本季會有流行性感冒。

examples.en: The infection was epidemic across several towns during the summer.
examples.zh: 這種感染在夏季於好幾個城鎮大規模流行。

examples.en: I watched the first episode of the series last night.
examples.zh: 我昨晚看了這部影集的第一集。

examples.en: The sad episode taught him an important lesson.
examples.zh: 那段傷心的插曲讓他學到了重要的一課。

examples.en: Each episode of the show is about thirty minutes long.
examples.zh: 這個節目每一集大約三十分鐘長。

examples.en: Can you solve this equation in your head?
examples.zh: 你能用心算解出這個方程式嗎？

examples.en: Our math teacher wrote a long equation on the board.
examples.zh: 我們的數學老師在黑板上寫了一個很長的方程式。

examples.en: Money is only one part of the equation when you choose a job.
examples.zh: 選擇工作時，薪水只是考量因素之一。

examples.en: The new law aims to bring more equity to the school system.
examples.zh: 這項新法律的目的是為學校體系帶來更多公平。

examples.en: She owns a large share of equity in the company.
examples.zh: 她擁有這家公司的大量股權。

examples.en: His equity in the house has risen over the past ten years.
examples.zh: 他持有的房屋淨值在過去十年間增加了。

examples.en: The volcano erupted without warning last night.
examples.zh: 那座火山昨晚毫無預警地噴發了。

examples.en: The crowd erupted into cheers when the team scored.
examples.zh: 球隊得分時，群眾爆出歡呼聲。

examples.en: An argument erupted between the two neighbors.
examples.zh: 兩位鄰居之間爆發了爭吵。

examples.en: The essence of this story is the value of friendship.
examples.zh: 這個故事的精髓在於友誼的價值。

examples.en: Honesty is the essence of a good relationship.
examples.zh: 誠實是良好關係的本質。

examples.en: This bottle contains the essence of fresh lemons.
examples.zh: 這個瓶子裡裝有新鮮檸檬的精華。

examples.en: They promised each other eternal friendship before leaving their hometown.
examples.zh: 離開家鄉前，他們彼此許下永恆的友誼。

examples.en: The poet wrote about the eternal beauty of nature.
examples.zh: 詩人寫下了大自然永恆的美。

examples.en: The couple exchanged rings as a symbol of eternal love.
examples.zh: 這對伴侶交換戒指，象徵永恆的愛。

examples.en: He is known for his strong work ethic.
examples.zh: 他以認真負責的工作態度著稱。

examples.en: The company has a clear ethic of honesty and respect.
examples.zh: 這間公司有明確的誠信與尊重的道德準則。

examples.en: Our teacher talked about the ethic of sharing with others.
examples.zh: 我們的老師談到與他人分享的道德觀。

examples.en: It is not ethical to copy another student's homework.
examples.zh: 抄襲其他同學的作業是不道德的。

examples.en: The company is proud of its ethical business practices.
examples.zh: 這家公司以其合乎倫理的經營方式為傲。

examples.en: Doctors must make ethical decisions every day.
examples.zh: 醫生每天都必須做出合乎倫理的決定。

examples.en: It is no exaggeration to say that she is the best singer in school.
examples.zh: 說她是學校裡最會唱歌的人一點也不誇張。

examples.en: His story about the fish was a huge exaggeration.
examples.zh: 他那個關於魚的故事實在太誇大了。

examples.en: The ad was an exaggeration, and the product did not work well.
examples.zh: 那則廣告很誇大，產品的效果並不好。

examples.en: Please do not exceed the speed limit on this road.
examples.zh: 在這條路上請不要超速。

examples.en: The cost of the trip exceeded our budget.
examples.zh: 這趟旅行的花費超出了我們的預算。

examples.en: The results exceeded everyone's expectations and impressed the entire team.
examples.zh: 結果超出了每個人的預期，讓整個團隊印象深刻。

examples.en: Excessive noise at night made it hard to sleep.
examples.zh: 夜裡過多的噪音讓人難以入睡。

examples.en: The store charged an excessive price for a bottle of water.
examples.zh: 那家店的一瓶水賣得貴得離譜。

examples.en: Excessive use of the phone can hurt your eyes.
examples.zh: 過度使用手機可能會傷害你的眼睛。

examples.en: The price excludes tax and service charges.
examples.zh: 這個價格不含稅金與服務費。

examples.en: They decided not to exclude anyone from the club.
examples.zh: 他們決定不把任何人排除在社團之外。

examples.en: Doctors asked her to exclude sugar from her diet.
examples.zh: 醫生要求她在飲食中不要攝取糖分。

examples.en: The magazine has an exclusive interview with the singer.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌有該歌手的獨家專訪。

examples.en: This lounge is exclusive to members of the tennis club.
examples.zh: 這間休息室專供網球俱樂部的會員使用。

examples.en: They live in an exclusive neighborhood near the lake.
examples.zh: 他們住在湖邊一個高級的社區。

examples.en: The newspaper got an exclusive on the scandal.
examples.zh: 這家報紙獨家報導了那起醜聞。

examples.en: The reporter was thrilled to get an exclusive about the new movie.
examples.zh: 記者很興奮能獨家報導這部新電影。

examples.en: The TV station promised viewers an exclusive tonight.
examples.zh: 電視台向觀眾保證今晚有獨家報導。

examples.en: The team will execute the plan next Monday.
examples.zh: 團隊將在下週一執行這項計畫。

examples.en: The program will execute as soon as you click the button.
examples.zh: 你一按下按鈕，程式就會開始執行。

examples.en: The artist carefully executed every line of the painting.
examples.zh: 那位藝術家仔細地完成了畫作的每一筆線條。

examples.en: The execution of the plan took longer than we expected.
examples.zh: 這項計畫的執行比我們預期的花了更長的時間。

examples.en: The judge stopped the execution after new evidence proved his innocence.
examples.zh: 新證據證明他無辜後，法官中止了處決。

examples.en: The team praised the smooth execution of the new program.
examples.zh: 團隊稱讚新方案執行得很順利。

examples.en: The writer spent ten years in exile before returning home.
examples.zh: 這位作家流亡十年後才回到家鄉。

examples.en: The exiles finally returned home after many years abroad.
examples.zh: 這些流亡者在海外多年後，終於返回家鄉。

examples.en: After the war, the old king lived quietly in exile.
examples.zh: 戰後，那位老國王在流亡中過著平靜的生活。

examples.en: The king decided to exile his advisor from the country.
examples.zh: 國王決定把他的顧問放逐出境。

examples.en: They were exiled for speaking against the government.
examples.zh: 他們因為批評政府而被放逐。

examples.en: The council voted to exile the leader from the city.
examples.zh: 議會投票決定把那位領袖逐出這座城市。

examples.en: We tried some exotic fruits at the night market.
examples.zh: 我們在夜市試吃了一些異國水果。

examples.en: She dreams of traveling to exotic places around the world.
examples.zh: 她夢想到世界各地充滿異國情調的地方旅行。

examples.en: The restaurant serves exotic dishes from South America.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳供應來自南美洲的異國料理。

examples.en: The scientists joined an expedition to the North Pole.
examples.zh: 科學家們加入了前往北極的探險隊。

examples.en: Our expedition left the base camp before sunrise.
examples.zh: 我們的探險隊在日出前離開了基地營。

examples.en: The class planned a short expedition to the local wetlands.
examples.zh: 全班規畫了一趟前往當地濕地的短程考察。

examples.en: She has great expertise in computer security.
examples.zh: 她在電腦安全方面有很豐富的專業知識。

examples.en: We need someone with expertise in tax law.
examples.zh: 我們需要一位具備稅法專業知識的人。

examples.en: His expertise helped the company solve the problem quickly.
examples.zh: 他的專業能力幫助公司迅速解決了問題。

examples.en: The teacher gave us explicit instructions for the test.
examples.zh: 老師給了我們關於考試的明確指示。

examples.en: There is an explicit rule against eating in the library.
examples.zh: 圖書館裡有明文規定禁止飲食。

examples.en: He made an explicit promise to finish the work on time.
examples.zh: 他明確承諾會準時完成工作。

examples.en: Space exploration has taught us a lot about the universe.
examples.zh: 太空探索讓我們對宇宙有了許多認識。

examples.en: The children enjoyed the exploration of the old garden.
examples.zh: 孩子們很喜歡探索那座老花園。

examples.en: This book invites readers to begin their own exploration of art.
examples.zh: 這本書邀請讀者開始自己的藝術探索。

examples.en: The exterior of the building was painted bright white.
examples.zh: 這棟建築的外觀被漆成亮白色。

examples.en: They spent the weekend cleaning the exterior of their house.
examples.zh: 他們花了週末清洗房子的外牆。

examples.en: The car has a shiny exterior but an old engine.
examples.zh: 這輛車外觀光亮，引擎卻很老舊。

examples.en: Please paint the exterior walls before winter comes.
examples.zh: 請在冬天來臨前粉刷外牆。

examples.en: The exterior door was locked for the night.
examples.zh: 外側的門在夜間上了鎖。

examples.en: We checked the exterior surface of the pipe for cracks.
examples.zh: 我們檢查了水管外表面有沒有裂縫。

examples.en: You can save the files on an external hard drive.
examples.zh: 你可以把檔案存在外接式硬碟裡。

examples.en: External factors may affect the price of oil.
examples.zh: 外部因素可能會影響石油的價格。

examples.en: The company hired an external expert to review its accounts.
examples.zh: 公司聘請了一位外部專家來審查帳目。

examples.en: This soft fabric is perfect for making summer shirts.
examples.zh: 這種柔軟的布料很適合做夏天的襯衫。

examples.en: She chose a blue fabric for the new curtains.
examples.zh: 她為新窗簾選了藍色的布料。

examples.en: Friendship is part of the social fabric of a small town.
examples.zh: 友誼是小鎮社會結構的一部分。

examples.en: We had a fabulous time at the beach last weekend.
examples.zh: 我們上週末在海邊玩得非常開心。

examples.en: You look fabulous in that red dress.
examples.zh: 你穿那件紅色洋裝看起來好極了。

examples.en: The hotel offers a fabulous view of the mountains.
examples.zh: 這間旅館可以欣賞到絕佳的山景。

examples.en: A good map can facilitate travel in a new city.
examples.zh: 一張好地圖能讓人在陌生城市裡旅行更方便。

examples.en: The teacher will facilitate the group discussion after lunch.
examples.zh: 老師會協助引導午餐後的小組討論。

examples.en: New software may facilitate communication between departments.
examples.zh: 新軟體可以促進各部門之間的溝通。

examples.en: The faculty meets on the first Monday of every month.
examples.zh: 全體教師在每個月的第一個星期一開會。

examples.en: She teaches in the faculty of engineering at the university.
examples.zh: 她在這所大學的工學院任教。

examples.en: Grandpa still has all his mental faculties at the age of ninety.
examples.zh: 爺爺九十歲了，心智能力依然完好。

examples.en: Long flights often cause fatigue and headaches.
examples.zh: 長途飛行常會造成疲勞和頭痛。

examples.en: The driver stopped to rest because of fatigue.
examples.zh: 司機因為疲勞而停下來休息。

examples.en: Doctors say lack of sleep is a common cause of fatigue.
examples.zh: 醫生說睡眠不足是造成疲勞的常見原因。

examples.en: Fruits and vegetables are rich in fiber.
examples.zh: 水果和蔬菜富含纖維。

examples.en: This jacket is made of a strong synthetic fiber.
examples.zh: 這件外套是用堅韌的合成纖維製成的。

examples.en: The internet here runs through a fiber cable under the street.
examples.zh: 這裡的網路是透過埋在街道下的光纖電纜傳輸。

examples.en: We installed a water filter in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我們在廚房裝了一個濾水器。

examples.en: The coffee filter was full of wet grounds.
examples.zh: 咖啡濾紙裡全是濕的咖啡渣。

examples.en: She added a filter to make the photo look warmer.
examples.zh: 她加了一個濾鏡，讓照片看起來更溫暖。

examples.en: Please filter the water before you drink it.
examples.zh: 請先把水過濾再喝。

examples.en: You can filter the search results by price.
examples.zh: 你可以依價格篩選搜尋結果。

examples.en: The machine filters dust from the air.
examples.zh: 這台機器會過濾空氣中的灰塵。

examples.en: The government announced a new fiscal policy this week.
examples.zh: 政府本週宣布了新的財政政策。

examples.en: Our fiscal year begins in July.
examples.zh: 我們的會計年度從七月開始。

examples.en: The company reported strong profits in the last fiscal quarter.
examples.zh: 這家公司公布上一個會計季度的獲利很好。

examples.en: The company owns a fleet of delivery trucks.
examples.zh: 這家公司擁有一支送貨卡車車隊。

examples.en: A small fishing fleet left the harbor at dawn.
examples.zh: 一支小型漁船隊在黎明時離開了港口。

examples.en: The airline plans to add new planes to its fleet.
examples.zh: 這家航空公司計畫為機隊增添新飛機。

examples.en: Her fluency in English helped her get the job.
examples.zh: 她流利的英文幫助她得到了這份工作。

examples.en: Reading aloud every night can improve your fluency.
examples.zh: 每晚大聲朗讀可以提升你的流暢度。

examples.en: The test measures both fluency and accuracy.
examples.zh: 這項測驗同時評量流暢度與正確度。

examples.en: Drink plenty of fluid when you have a fever.
examples.zh: 發燒時要補充充足的水分。

examples.en: The mechanic checked the brake fluid in the car.
examples.zh: 技師檢查了這輛車的煞車油。

examples.en: Blood is a fluid that carries oxygen around the body.
examples.zh: 血液是一種在體內輸送氧氣的液體。

examples.en: The dancer's fluid movements amazed the audience.
examples.zh: 舞者流暢的動作讓觀眾驚嘆。

examples.en: The plan is still fluid, so we may change it.
examples.zh: 計畫還不確定，所以我們可能會更動。

examples.en: Water is a fluid substance at room temperature.
examples.zh: 水在室溫下是流動的物質。

examples.en: The blacksmith will forge a new gate for the farm.
examples.zh: 鐵匠會為農場打造一道新的大門。

examples.en: Someone tried to forge my signature on the form.
examples.zh: 有人試圖在表格上偽造我的簽名。

examples.en: The two schools hope to forge a strong partnership.
examples.zh: 兩所學校希望建立穩固的合作關係。

examples.en: The old forge in the village is now a museum.
examples.zh: 村裡那間舊鐵匠舖現在是一座博物館。

examples.en: Heat from the forge filled the small workshop.
examples.zh: 鍛造爐的熱氣充滿了小工坊。

examples.en: The blacksmith lit the forge early in the morning.
examples.zh: 鐵匠一大早就點燃了鍛造爐。

examples.en: Please send your report in PDF format.
examples.zh: 請以 PDF 格式寄出你的報告。

examples.en: The quiz show has a new format this season.
examples.zh: 這個益智節目這一季有了新的形式。

examples.en: Check the format of the date before you submit the form.
examples.zh: 送出表格前請先確認日期的格式。

examples.en: You need to format the USB drive before using it.
examples.zh: 使用這個隨身碟之前，你需要先將它格式化。

examples.en: She formatted the essay with wider margins.
examples.zh: 她把論文的邊界調寬來排版。

examples.en: Please format your resume in a clear and simple way.
examples.zh: 請用清楚簡單的方式為你的履歷排版。

senses.zh: 論壇；討論會；公開討論的場所

examples.en: I asked a question on an online forum about my laptop.
examples.zh: 我在網路論壇上問了一個關於我筆電的問題。

examples.en: The school held a forum on student safety.
examples.zh: 學校舉辦了一場關於學生安全的座談會。

examples.en: The town hall is a forum where residents share their ideas.
examples.zh: 市政廳是居民分享想法的公開場所。

examples.en: Good teachers foster a love of reading in children.
examples.zh: 好老師會培養孩子對閱讀的喜愛。

examples.en: The club aims to foster friendship among new students.
examples.zh: 這個社團的目標是促進新生之間的友誼。

examples.en: Our neighbors decided to foster two kittens for a month.
examples.zh: 我們的鄰居決定暫時照顧兩隻小貓一個月。

examples.en: She grew up in a foster family after her parents moved abroad.
examples.zh: 她在父母搬到國外後，在寄養家庭中長大。

examples.en: The foster parents treated the boy like their own son.
examples.zh: 寄養父母把這個男孩當作自己的兒子一樣對待。

examples.en: The school offers support to foster children and their caregivers.
examples.zh: 學校為寄養兒童及其照顧者提供支援。

examples.en: A foul smell came from the old refrigerator.
examples.zh: 一股惡臭從那台舊冰箱傳出來。

examples.en: The foul weather forced us to cancel the picnic.
examples.zh: 惡劣的天氣迫使我們取消了野餐。

examples.en: The river was too foul for anyone to swim in.
examples.zh: 這條河太髒了，沒有人能在裡面游泳。

examples.en: The referee called a foul on the tall player.
examples.zh: 裁判對那位高個子球員吹了犯規。

examples.en: He made three fouls in the first half.
examples.zh: 他在上半場犯規三次。

examples.en: The coach was upset about the foul in the last minute.
examples.zh: 教練對最後一分鐘的犯規感到不高興。

examples.en: Three quarters is a fraction we learned in math class.
examples.zh: 四分之三是我們在數學課學到的一種分數。

examples.en: Only a small fraction of students walk to school.
examples.zh: 只有一小部分學生走路上學。

examples.en: The new phone costs a fraction of the old price.
examples.zh: 這支新手機的價格只有舊價格的一小部分。

examples.en: She swept up the fragments of the broken cup.
examples.zh: 她把破掉的杯子碎片掃乾淨。

examples.en: I only heard a fragment of their conversation.
examples.zh: 我只聽到他們對話的片段。

examples.en: Archaeologists found a fragment of an ancient bowl.
examples.zh: 考古學家發現了一塊古代碗的碎片。

examples.en: The glass fell and fragmented on the floor.
examples.zh: 玻璃掉下去，在地板上碎裂開來。

examples.en: Too many small shops fragment the market.
examples.zh: 太多小商店使市場變得分散。

examples.en: The old wall began to fragment after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 那面舊牆在大雨後開始碎裂。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a framework for writing the essay.
examples.zh: 老師給了我們寫這篇作文的架構。

examples.en: The workers built a steel framework for the new bridge.
examples.zh: 工人為新橋搭建了鋼骨框架。

examples.en: This law creates a framework for protecting personal data.
examples.zh: 這項法律建立了保護個人資料的體系。

senses.zh: 加盟權；連鎖企業；加盟店

examples.en: He bought a franchise of a famous coffee shop.
examples.zh: 他買下了一家知名咖啡店的加盟權。

examples.en: The franchise has more than two hundred stores in Asia.
examples.zh: 這個連鎖品牌在亞洲有兩百多家分店。

examples.en: She hopes to open a franchise near the train station.
examples.zh: 她希望在火車站附近開一家加盟店。

examples.en: The bank is investigating a case of credit card fraud.
examples.zh: 銀行正在調查一起信用卡詐欺案。

examples.en: He was accused of fraud after the company lost money.
examples.zh: 公司虧損後，他被指控詐欺。

examples.en: The man who sold fake tickets turned out to be a fraud.
examples.zh: 賣假票的那個人原來是個騙子。

examples.en: The train crossed the frontier early in the morning.
examples.zh: 火車在清晨越過了邊境。

examples.en: Soldiers guarded the frontier between the two countries.
examples.zh: 衛兵守衛著兩國之間的邊界。

examples.en: Space is often called the final frontier of human exploration.
examples.zh: 太空常被稱為人類探索的最後疆域。

examples.en: Our solar system is part of the Milky Way galaxy.
examples.zh: 我們的太陽系是銀河系的一部分。

examples.en: The telescope took a clear picture of a distant galaxy.
examples.zh: 望遠鏡拍下了一個遙遠星系的清晰照片。

examples.en: A large galaxy can contain hundreds of billions of stars.
examples.zh: 一個大型星系可能包含數千億顆恆星。

examples.en: The audience gasped when the lights suddenly went out.
examples.zh: 燈光突然熄滅時，觀眾都倒抽了一口氣。

examples.en: She gasped for air after running up the stairs.
examples.zh: 她跑上樓梯後上氣不接下氣。

examples.en: We gasped at the beautiful view from the top of the hill.
examples.zh: 我們看到山頂美麗的景色時驚嘆不已。

examples.en: A gasp of surprise filled the classroom.
examples.zh: 教室裡響起了一陣驚訝的倒抽氣聲。

examples.en: He let out a gasp when he opened the box.
examples.zh: 他打開盒子時倒抽了一口氣。

examples.en: With a gasp, she dropped the heavy bag.
examples.zh: 她倒抽一口氣，沉重的袋子隨之掉到地上。

examples.en: We have a family gathering at my grandmother's house every holiday.
examples.zh: 每逢假日，我們都會在外婆家舉行家庭聚會。

examples.en: A large gathering of fans waited outside the stadium.
examples.zh: 一大群球迷聚集在體育場外等候。

examples.en: The school invited parents to a gathering in the hall.
examples.zh: 學校邀請家長到禮堂參加聚會。

examples.en: Solar panels can generate electricity for the whole house.
examples.zh: 太陽能板可以為整棟房子發電。

examples.en: The new shop generated a lot of interest in the neighborhood.
examples.zh: 這家新店在社區裡引起了很多關注。

examples.en: The program will generate a report at the end of the month.
examples.zh: 這個程式會在月底產生一份報告。

examples.en: The hospital has a backup generator in case of a power cut.
examples.zh: 醫院備有發電機，以防停電。

examples.en: We used a small generator during the camping trip.
examples.zh: 我們在露營時使用了一台小型發電機。

examples.en: The generator makes a loud noise when it runs.
examples.zh: 這台發電機運轉時會發出很大的聲音。

examples.en: Some diseases are caused by genetic problems.
examples.zh: 有些疾病是由基因問題引起的。

examples.en: The doctor asked about our family's genetic history.
examples.zh: 醫生詢問了我們家族的遺傳病史。

examples.en: Scientists are studying the genetic code of the plant.
examples.zh: 科學家正在研究這種植物的基因密碼。

examples.en: She decided to study genetics at university.
examples.zh: 她決定在大學主修遺傳學。

examples.en: Genetics can explain why some families have the same eye color.
examples.zh: 遺傳學能解釋為什麼有些家族的眼睛顏色相同。

examples.en: Advances in genetics have changed modern medicine.
examples.zh: 遺傳學的進步改變了現代醫學。

examples.en: Science fiction is my favorite genre of movies.
examples.zh: 科幻片是我最喜愛的電影類型。

examples.en: What genre of music do you listen to most?
examples.zh: 你最常聽哪一種類型的音樂？

examples.en: The library has separate shelves for each genre.
examples.zh: 圖書館的每種體裁都有各自的書架。

examples.en: The glare of the sun made it hard to see the road.
examples.zh: 太陽的刺眼強光讓人很難看清路面。

examples.en: He gave his brother an angry glare.
examples.zh: 他憤怒地瞪了弟弟一眼。

examples.en: Sunglasses protect your eyes from the glare.
examples.zh: 太陽眼鏡能保護你的眼睛不受強光刺激。

examples.en: The teacher glared at the students who were talking.
examples.zh: 老師瞪著正在講話的學生。

examples.en: The sun glared off the windows of the tall building.
examples.zh: 陽光從高樓的窗戶反射出刺眼的光。

examples.en: She glared at me when I took her seat.
examples.zh: 我坐了她的位子，她就瞪了我一眼。

senses.zh: 陰暗的；憂鬱的；前景黯淡的

examples.en: It was a gloomy day with dark clouds all over the sky.
examples.zh: 那天天色陰暗，滿天都是烏雲。

examples.en: He felt gloomy after failing the exam.
examples.zh: 他考試不及格後心情很低落。

examples.en: The future of the company looks gloomy this year.
examples.zh: 這家公司今年的前景看起來黯淡。

examples.en: The bride looked gorgeous in her white dress.
examples.zh: 新娘穿著白色禮服，看起來美極了。

examples.en: We watched a gorgeous sunset from the hotel balcony.
examples.zh: 我們在旅館陽台上欣賞了一場絕美的夕陽。

examples.en: It is a gorgeous day, so let's go for a walk.
examples.zh: 今天天氣好極了，我們去散步吧。

examples.en: She works as a graphic designer for a small company.
examples.zh: 她在一家小公司擔任平面設計師。

examples.en: The book gives a graphic description of life on a farm.
examples.zh: 這本書生動地描寫了農場的生活。

examples.en: A graphic chart made the numbers easier to understand.
examples.zh: 一張圖表讓這些數字更容易理解。

examples.en: The report includes a graphic showing sales by month.
examples.zh: 報告中有一張顯示每月銷售額的圖表。

examples.en: Add a graphic to your slide to make it more interesting.
examples.zh: 在你的投影片中加一張圖像，讓它更有趣。

examples.en: The website uses a bright graphic on its front page.
examples.zh: 這個網站的首頁使用了一張鮮明的圖像。

examples.en: The story shows how greed can ruin a person's life.
examples.zh: 這個故事說明了貪婪如何毀掉一個人的生活。

examples.en: His greed for money made him lose many friends.
examples.zh: 他對金錢的貪婪使他失去了許多朋友。

examples.en: Greed led the company to ignore its workers.
examples.zh: 貪婪使公司忽視了員工。

examples.en: Dad cleaned the grill before the barbecue party.
examples.zh: 爸爸在烤肉派對前把烤架清乾淨。

examples.en: We bought a small grill for the backyard.
examples.zh: 我們為後院買了一個小烤肉爐。

examples.en: The new grill on Main Street is always crowded.
examples.zh: 大街上那家新開的燒烤餐廳總是很擠。

examples.en: We will grill fish and vegetables for dinner.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐要烤魚和蔬菜。

examples.en: He grilled the corn until it turned golden.
examples.zh: 他把玉米烤到變成金黃色。

examples.en: Please grill the chicken for about ten minutes.
examples.zh: 請把雞肉烤大約十分鐘。

senses.zh: 嚴峻的；凝重的；令人沮喪的

examples.en: The doctor had a grim look on her face.
examples.zh: 醫生臉上的表情很凝重。

examples.en: The news about the flood was grim.
examples.zh: 關於洪水的消息令人沮喪。

examples.en: The situation looks grim for the small farm.
examples.zh: 這座小農場的處境看起來很嚴峻。

examples.en: He kept a firm grip on the rope.
examples.zh: 他緊緊抓住那條繩子。

examples.en: The new tires have a better grip on wet roads.
examples.zh: 新輪胎在濕滑路面上有更好的抓地力。

examples.en: The company finally lost its grip on the market.
examples.zh: 這家公司終於失去了對市場的掌控。

examples.en: The little girl gripped her mother's hand tightly.
examples.zh: 小女孩緊緊握住媽媽的手。

examples.en: The story gripped the readers from the first page.
examples.zh: 這個故事從第一頁起就緊緊抓住讀者。

examples.en: Please grip the handle with both hands.
examples.zh: 請用雙手握住把手。

examples.en: The company's gross income rose by ten percent this year.
examples.zh: 公司今年的總收入增加了百分之十。

examples.en: The gross weight of the box is five kilograms.
examples.zh: 這個箱子的毛重是五公斤。

examples.en: The smell from the garbage was really gross.
examples.zh: 垃圾的氣味真的很噁心。

examples.en: The school has clear guidelines for using computers.
examples.zh: 學校對使用電腦訂有明確的指引。

examples.en: Follow the safety guidelines when you enter the lab.
examples.zh: 進入實驗室時請遵守安全準則。

examples.en: The guideline says students should wear their uniforms.
examples.zh: 這項指引指出，學生應穿著制服。

examples.en: Yogurt is good for your gut health.
examples.zh: 優格對腸道健康有益。

examples.en: My gut told me that something was wrong.
examples.zh: 我的直覺告訴我有地方不對勁。

examples.en: He felt a sharp pain in his gut after lunch.
examples.zh: 他午餐後覺得腹部劇烈疼痛。

examples.en: The fisherman gutted the fish before cooking it.
examples.zh: 漁夫在烹煮前先取出魚的內臟。

examples.en: Workers gutted the old building to make a new office.
examples.zh: 工人把舊大樓裡面全部拆空，改建成新的辦公室。

examples.en: She gutted the chicken and washed it carefully.
examples.zh: 她取出雞的內臟並仔細清洗。

examples.en: The forest is a natural habitat for many kinds of birds.
examples.zh: 森林是許多種鳥類的天然棲息地。

examples.en: Pollution is destroying the habitat of sea turtles.
examples.zh: 汙染正在破壞海龜的棲息地。

examples.en: The zoo tries to copy the animals' wild habitat.
examples.zh: 動物園試著複製動物們的野外棲息環境。

examples.en: Two workers hauled the heavy boxes up the stairs.
examples.zh: 兩名工人把沉重的箱子拖上樓梯。

examples.en: The truck hauls fresh vegetables to the market every morning.
examples.zh: 這輛卡車每天早上把新鮮蔬菜運到市場。

examples.en: We had to haul our luggage across the station.
examples.zh: 我們得拖著行李穿過車站。

examples.en: The fishermen came home with a large haul of fish.
examples.zh: 漁夫們帶著一大批漁獲回家了。

examples.en: It was a long haul from the airport to the hotel.
examples.zh: 從機場到飯店是一段很遠的路程。

examples.en: She showed her shopping haul in an online video.
examples.zh: 她在網路影片中展示了這次購物的戰利品。

examples.en: Wet floors are a safety hazard in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 濕滑的地板是廚房裡的安全風險。

examples.en: Smoking is a serious health hazard.
examples.zh: 吸菸是嚴重的健康危害。

examples.en: Please remove any fire hazard from the hallway.
examples.zh: 請清除走廊上任何可能引發火災的危險物。

examples.en: I will hazard a guess that the test is on Friday.
examples.zh: 我來大膽猜一下，考試是在星期五。

examples.en: He did not want to hazard his savings on a risky plan.
examples.zh: 他不想拿自己的積蓄去冒險投入一項高風險的計畫。

examples.en: Nobody would hazard an opinion about the new rule.
examples.zh: 沒有人敢對這項新規定發表看法。

examples.en: He is the only heir to his uncle's farm.
examples.zh: 他是他叔叔農場唯一的繼承人。

examples.en: The prince is the heir to the throne.
examples.zh: 這位王子是王位的繼承人。

examples.en: The lawyer read the will to the three heirs.
examples.zh: 律師對三位繼承人宣讀了遺囑。

examples.en: She added fresh herbs to the soup for more flavor.
examples.zh: 她在湯裡加了新鮮香草來增添風味。

examples.en: My grandmother grows herbs that are used in traditional medicine.
examples.zh: 我奶奶種植可用於傳統醫藥的藥草。

examples.en: Many people drink herbal tea before going to bed.
examples.zh: 許多人睡前會喝香草茶。

examples.en: The old temple is an important part of our cultural heritage.
examples.zh: 這座古廟是我們文化遺產的重要一部分。

examples.en: The festival celebrates the heritage of the local people.
examples.zh: 這個節慶是為了慶祝當地人的傳統。

examples.en: The city has a rich heritage of music and food.
examples.zh: 這座城市擁有豐富的音樂與美食傳統。

examples.en: Please highlight the key words in each paragraph.
examples.zh: 請把每一段的關鍵字標示出來。

examples.en: The report highlights the need for more teachers.
examples.zh: 這份報告強調了需要更多教師。

examples.en: She used a yellow pen to highlight the date.
examples.zh: 她用黃色的筆把日期標示出來。

examples.en: The highlight of the trip was the boat ride at sunset.
examples.zh: 這趟旅行最精采的部分是日落時的搭船之旅。

examples.en: Watch the highlights of last night's game online.
examples.zh: 請上網收看昨晚比賽的精采片段。

examples.en: The museum visit was the highlight of our school trip.
examples.zh: 參觀博物館是我們校外教學的亮點。

examples.en: My brother plays hockey for his school team.
examples.zh: 我哥哥在學校代表隊打曲棍球。

examples.en: We watched an exciting hockey game on TV last night.
examples.zh: 我們昨晚在電視上看了一場刺激的曲棍球比賽。

examples.en: You need a stick and a puck to play ice hockey.
examples.zh: 打冰上曲棍球需要一支球桿和一個冰球。

examples.en: Draw a horizontal line across the middle of the page.
examples.zh: 請在紙的中間畫一條水平線。

examples.en: The table has horizontal stripes on its surface.
examples.zh: 這張桌子表面有橫條紋。

examples.en: Put the board in a horizontal position before you measure it.
examples.zh: 測量之前，請先把木板擺成水平。

examples.en: Growth hormone helps children grow taller as their bodies develop.
examples.zh: 生長激素會在孩子身體發育時幫助他們長高。

examples.en: Stress can change the levels of hormones in the body.
examples.zh: 壓力會改變體內的荷爾蒙濃度。

examples.en: The doctor checked her hormone levels with a blood test.
examples.zh: 醫師用血液檢查確認了她的荷爾蒙濃度。

examples.en: The new student felt that the class was hostile to him.
examples.zh: 那位新同學覺得班上同學對他不友善。

examples.en: The desert is a hostile environment for most plants.
examples.zh: 沙漠對大多數植物來說是惡劣的環境。

examples.en: She gave me a hostile look when I walked in.
examples.zh: 我走進去時，她對我投以不友善的眼神。

examples.en: There was open hostility between the two neighbors.
examples.zh: 那兩位鄰居之間有公開的敵意。

examples.en: He spoke without any hostility in his voice.
examples.zh: 他說話時語氣中沒有一絲敵意。

examples.en: The plan met strong hostility from local residents.
examples.zh: 這項計畫遭到當地居民強烈的反對。

examples.en: The wolves howled at the moon all night.
examples.zh: 狼群整晚對著月亮嚎叫。

examples.en: The wind howled outside the window during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間，風在窗外呼嘯。

examples.en: The baby howled when his mother left the room.
examples.zh: 媽媽離開房間時，寶寶放聲大哭。

examples.en: We heard a long howl from the hills.
examples.zh: 我們聽到山丘那邊傳來一聲長長的嚎叫。

examples.en: The dog let out a sad howl at the door.
examples.zh: 那隻狗在門口發出悲傷的嚎叫。

examples.en: A howl of laughter filled the classroom.
examples.zh: 一陣哄堂大笑聲充滿了教室。

examples.en: The scientist tested her hypothesis with a simple experiment.
examples.zh: 這位科學家用一個簡單的實驗來驗證她的假說。

examples.en: Our hypothesis is that plants grow faster in sunlight.
examples.zh: 我們的假設是植物在陽光下長得比較快。

examples.en: The results did not support his hypothesis.
examples.zh: 實驗結果並不支持他的假設。

examples.en: The two parties follow very different ideologies.
examples.zh: 這兩個政黨奉行截然不同的意識形態。

examples.en: The book explains the ideology behind the movement.
examples.zh: 這本書說明了該運動背後的思想體系。

examples.en: Students should learn to think beyond one ideology.
examples.zh: 學生應該學會跳脫單一意識形態來思考。

examples.en: I felt like an idiot when I forgot my own address.
examples.zh: 我忘了自己的地址時，覺得自己像個笨蛋。

examples.en: Don't call your little brother an idiot.
examples.zh: 不要叫你弟弟笨蛋。

examples.en: Only an idiot would leave the door open in the rain.
examples.zh: 只有笨蛋才會在下雨時把門開著。

examples.en: The magician created the illusion of a floating ball.
examples.zh: 魔術師製造出球在漂浮的假象。

examples.en: This picture is a famous optical illusion.
examples.zh: 這張圖是一個著名的視覺錯覺。

examples.en: Mirrors on the wall give the illusion of a bigger room.
examples.zh: 牆上的鏡子讓房間看起來比較大。

examples.en: The whale is an immense animal that needs plenty of food.
examples.zh: 鯨魚是一種體型巨大、需要充足食物的動物。

examples.en: The new library is of immense value to our town.
examples.zh: 這間新圖書館對我們鎮上來說價值非凡。

examples.en: She felt immense pride when her son won the prize.
examples.zh: 兒子得獎時，她感到無比的驕傲。

senses.zh: 有免疫力的；不受影響的；享有豁免的

examples.en: Children who get the vaccine become immune to the disease.
examples.zh: 接種疫苗的孩子會對這種疾病產生免疫力。

examples.en: No one is immune to making mistakes.
examples.zh: 沒有人不會犯錯。

examples.en: Diplomats may be immune from prosecution under certain legal agreements.
examples.zh: 根據某些法律協定，外交官可能享有免受起訴的豁免權。

examples.en: I bought the shoes on impulse and later regretted it.
examples.zh: 我一時衝動買了那雙鞋，後來很後悔。

examples.en: She had a sudden impulse to call her old friend.
examples.zh: 她突然有股衝動想打電話給老朋友。

examples.en: Nerves send electrical impulses to the brain.
examples.zh: 神經會把電脈衝傳送到大腦。

examples.en: The company offers a bonus as an incentive to work harder.
examples.zh: 公司提供獎金作為努力工作的誘因。

examples.en: Lower prices give people an incentive to buy more.
examples.zh: 較低的價格會促使人們多買一些。

examples.en: Good grades can be a strong incentive for students.
examples.zh: 好成績對學生來說可以是很強的動機。

examples.en: The chef likes to incorporate local fruit into his desserts.
examples.zh: 這位主廚喜歡把當地水果融入他的甜點中。

examples.en: Please incorporate my suggestions into the final report.
examples.zh: 請把我的建議納入最後的報告中。

examples.en: The new phone incorporates several useful features.
examples.zh: 這支新手機包含了幾項實用的功能。

examples.en: Look up the word in the index at the back of the book.
examples.zh: 請在書後的索引裡查這個字。

examples.en: The stock index rose by two percent after the news.
examples.zh: 股價指數在消息公布後上漲了百分之二。

examples.en: The price index shows that food costs are going up.
examples.zh: 物價指數顯示食品成本正在上升。

senses.zh: 為…編索引；使與指數連動

examples.en: The librarian will index all the new books this week.
examples.zh: 圖書館員這星期會為所有新書編索引。

examples.en: The software can index thousands of files in a minute.
examples.zh: 這套軟體一分鐘就能為數千個檔案建立索引。

examples.en: Some salaries are indexed to the cost of living.
examples.zh: 有些薪資是與生活費用連動的。

senses.zh: 漠不關心的；冷淡的；無所謂的

examples.en: He seemed indifferent to the result of the game.
examples.zh: 他似乎對比賽結果漠不關心。

examples.en: The waiter was indifferent and did not smile at us.
examples.zh: 那位服務生態度冷淡，也沒對我們微笑。

examples.en: I am indifferent about which movie we watch.
examples.zh: 看哪一部電影我都無所謂。

examples.en: The museum has a display of indigenous art.
examples.zh: 博物館有一個原住民藝術的展區。

examples.en: Bamboo is indigenous to many parts of Asia.
examples.zh: 竹子原產於亞洲的許多地區。

examples.en: The indigenous people of the island have their own language.
examples.zh: 這座島上的原住民有自己的語言。

examples.en: A good dictionary is indispensable for language learners.
examples.zh: 好的字典對語言學習者來說不可或缺。

examples.en: Water is indispensable to all living things.
examples.zh: 水對所有生物來說都是不可或缺的。

examples.en: She made herself indispensable to the team.
examples.zh: 她讓自己成為團隊中不可或缺的一員。

examples.en: On weekends I like to indulge in a long, hot bath.
examples.zh: 週末我喜歡好好享受長時間泡熱水澡的樂趣。

examples.en: Grandparents often indulge their grandchildren with sweets.
examples.zh: 祖父母常常用甜食縱容孫子孫女。

examples.en: He indulged himself with a slice of chocolate cake.
examples.zh: 他放縱自己吃了一塊巧克力蛋糕。

examples.en: The universe seems to be infinite, but scientists are still investigating.
examples.zh: 宇宙似乎是無限的，但科學家仍在研究這個問題。

examples.en: Our teacher has infinite patience with young children.
examples.zh: 我們的老師對年幼的孩子有無窮的耐心。

examples.en: There are infinite ways to solve this puzzle.
examples.zh: 解開這個謎題有無數種方法。

examples.en: The government plans to spend more on infrastructure.
examples.zh: 政府打算在基礎建設上投入更多經費。

examples.en: Good roads and bridges are part of a country's infrastructure.
examples.zh: 良好的道路和橋梁是一個國家基礎建設的一部分。

examples.en: The storm badly damaged the city's infrastructure.
examples.zh: 這場暴風雨嚴重破壞了這座城市的基礎設施。

examples.en: Every sport has some inherent risk, even with proper safety equipment.
examples.zh: 即使有適當的安全裝備，每種運動仍有某些固有的風險。

examples.en: Curiosity is inherent in young children and helps them learn.
examples.zh: 好奇心是幼童與生俱來的特質，也能幫助他們學習。

examples.en: The plan has an inherent weakness that we must fix.
examples.zh: 這項計畫有個本質上的弱點，我們必須改善。

examples.en: The school will initiate a new reading program next month.
examples.zh: 學校下個月將啟動一項新的閱讀計畫。

examples.en: She was the first to initiate a conversation at the party.
examples.zh: 她是派對上第一個主動開啟話題的人。

examples.en: The company initiated a review of its safety rules.
examples.zh: 公司發起了一項安全規定的檢討。

examples.en: She showed initiative by cleaning the room without being asked.
examples.zh: 她不用人交代就主動打掃房間，展現了積極的態度。

examples.en: The city launched an initiative to plant more trees.
examples.zh: 市政府推出了一項多種樹的倡議。

examples.en: You must take the initiative if you want to learn faster.
examples.zh: 如果你想學得更快，就得採取主動。

examples.en: Our team scored two runs in the first inning.
examples.zh: 我們隊在第一局拿下兩分。

examples.en: The game went to the ninth inning before anyone scored.
examples.zh: 比賽打到第九局才有人得分。

examples.en: He pitched for the whole inning without a mistake.
examples.zh: 他整局投球都沒有失誤。

examples.en: Smartphones were a major innovation in communication.
examples.zh: 智慧型手機是通訊領域的一大創新。

examples.en: The company is famous for its innovation in design.
examples.zh: 這家公司以設計創新聞名。

examples.en: Recent innovations are changing the way customers shop online.
examples.zh: 近來的創新成果正在改變顧客網購的方式。

examples.en: The teacher used an innovative way to explain fractions.
examples.zh: 老師用一種創新的方式來解釋分數。

examples.en: This innovative app helps people save water at home.
examples.zh: 這款創新的應用程式能幫助人們在家節約用水。

examples.en: She is an innovative designer with many fresh ideas.
examples.zh: 她是一位有許多新點子的創意設計師。

examples.en: The traffic in the city center was insane this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上市中心的交通狀況糟透了。

examples.en: That price is insane for such a small room.
examples.zh: 這麼小的房間卻開這種價錢，實在太離譜。

examples.en: Waiting three hours for a bus would drive me insane.
examples.zh: 等三個小時的公車會把我逼瘋。

examples.en: The book gives readers a deep insight into Japanese culture.
examples.zh: 這本書讓讀者對日本文化有深入的瞭解。

examples.en: Her insight helped the team solve the problem quickly.
examples.zh: 她的洞察力幫助團隊很快解決了問題。

examples.en: The interview offers a useful insight into his thinking.
examples.zh: 這場訪談有助於深入瞭解他的想法。

examples.en: The installation of the new software took about ten minutes.
examples.zh: 新軟體的安裝大約花了十分鐘。

examples.en: A technician will come for the installation of the air conditioner.
examples.zh: 技師會來安裝冷氣機。

examples.en: The art installation in the park attracts many visitors.
examples.zh: 公園裡的裝置藝術吸引了許多遊客。

examples.en: The vase arrived intact after the long trip.
examples.zh: 那個花瓶經過長途運送後仍完好無缺。

examples.en: Most of the old city wall is still intact.
examples.zh: 舊城牆大部分仍然保持完整。

examples.en: Her trust in him remained intact despite the rumors about his past.
examples.zh: 儘管有關於他過去的傳聞，她對他的信任仍絲毫未減。

examples.en: The school plans to integrate computers into every class.
examples.zh: 學校打算把電腦融入每一堂課。

examples.en: It takes time for new students to integrate into the group.
examples.zh: 新同學需要時間才能融入團體。

examples.en: This app can integrate all your calendars in one place.
examples.zh: 這個應用程式可以把你所有的行事曆整合在同一處。

examples.en: The integration of the two companies took a year.
examples.zh: 這兩家公司的整合花了一年的時間。

examples.en: Language classes help the integration of new immigrants.
examples.zh: 語言課程有助於新移民融入社會。

examples.en: The integration of music and math is an interesting topic.
examples.zh: 音樂與數學的結合是個有趣的主題。

examples.en: He is a man of great integrity and never lies.
examples.zh: 他是個非常正直的人，從不說謊。

examples.en: The judge is respected for her honesty and integrity.
examples.zh: 那位法官因誠實與正直而受到尊敬。

examples.en: Cracks in the wall may damage the integrity of the building.
examples.zh: 牆上的裂縫可能會破壞建築物的結構完整性。

examples.en: I had no intent to hurt your feelings.
examples.zh: 我無意傷害你的感受。

examples.en: The intent of the rule is to keep students safe.
examples.zh: 這條規定的目的是確保學生的安全。

examples.en: She sent the email with the intent of asking for help.
examples.zh: 她寄這封電子郵件是為了請求協助。

examples.en: The boy was intent on finishing his homework before dinner.
examples.zh: 那個男孩一心想在晚餐前寫完功課。

examples.en: She listened with an intent look on her face.
examples.zh: 她臉上帶著專注的神情聆聽著。

examples.en: The cat was intent on catching the little bird.
examples.zh: 那隻貓一心想抓住那隻小鳥。

examples.en: The interior of the house is bright and clean.
examples.zh: 這棟房子的內部明亮又乾淨。

examples.en: The interior of the country is mostly mountains.
examples.zh: 這個國家的內陸大多是山區。

examples.en: We painted the interior of the room light yellow.
examples.zh: 我們把房間內部漆成了淡黃色。

examples.en: The interior walls are made of wood.
examples.zh: 室內的牆壁是用木頭做的。

examples.en: She works as an interior designer for a hotel.
examples.zh: 她在一家飯店擔任室內設計師。

examples.en: Please use the interior stairs during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間請使用室內樓梯。

examples.en: The teacher's quick intervention stopped the argument.
examples.zh: 老師迅速的介入制止了這場爭吵。

examples.en: Early intervention can help children with reading problems.
examples.zh: 及早介入可以幫助有閱讀困難的孩子。

examples.en: The patient needed medical intervention right away.
examples.zh: 這位病人需要立即接受醫療處置。

examples.en: The investigator asked the manager several questions.
examples.zh: 調查員問了經理幾個問題。

examples.en: A private investigator was hired to find the missing dog.
examples.zh: 一位私家偵探受雇尋找走失的狗。

examples.en: Insurance investigators checked the damage to the car.
examples.zh: 保險調查員查看了這輛車的損壞情形。

examples.en: There is some irony in a fire station catching fire.
examples.zh: 消防隊失火這件事有點諷刺。

examples.en: Her voice was full of irony when she thanked him.
examples.zh: 她向他道謝時，語氣中充滿了諷刺。

examples.en: The irony is that the guide got lost in his own hometown.
examples.zh: 諷刺的是，那位導遊竟在自己的家鄉迷路了。

examples.en: My sister studies journalism at a university in Taipei.
examples.zh: 我姊姊在台北的一所大學讀新聞系。

examples.en: Good journalism depends on checking the facts.
examples.zh: 好的新聞報導取決於查證事實。

examples.en: He left a job in business to work in journalism.
examples.zh: 他離開商界的工作，轉而投入新聞業。

examples.en: The country has a fair judicial system.
examples.zh: 這個國家有公平的司法制度。

examples.en: The judge ordered a judicial review of the case.
examples.zh: 法官下令對這個案件進行司法審查。

examples.en: Judicial decisions must follow the law.
examples.zh: 司法判決必須依法而定。

examples.en: She poured milk from the jug into the glass.
examples.zh: 她把牛奶從壺裡倒進杯子裡。

examples.en: There is a big jug of water on the table.
examples.zh: 桌上有一大壺水。

examples.en: We filled the jug with orange juice for the party.
examples.zh: 我們為派對在壺裡裝滿了柳橙汁。

examples.en: How can you justify spending so much money on one jacket?
examples.zh: 你要怎麼證明花這麼多錢買一件外套是合理的？

examples.en: The manager could not justify the sudden price increase to customers.
examples.zh: 經理無法向顧客說明價格突然上漲的理由。

examples.en: Nothing can justify cheating on an exam.
examples.zh: 沒有任何理由可以為考試作弊辯解。

examples.en: The library has a special section for juvenile books.
examples.zh: 圖書館有一區專門放青少年讀物。

examples.en: His juvenile jokes made the teacher sigh.
examples.zh: 他幼稚的笑話讓老師嘆了口氣。

examples.en: The city opened a new center for juvenile sports programs.
examples.zh: 市政府為青少年運動課程開設了新的中心。

examples.en: The juvenile was asked to join a community service project.
examples.zh: 那位青少年被邀請參加社區服務計畫。

examples.en: A juvenile eagle stayed close to its nest.
examples.zh: 一隻幼鷹待在離巢很近的地方。

examples.en: Each juvenile in the program receives a mentor.
examples.zh: 這個計畫中的每位青少年都有一位導師。

examples.en: The lawmaker visited our school to talk about education.
examples.zh: 那位立法委員來我們學校談教育議題。

examples.en: Several lawmakers voted for the new traffic rules.
examples.zh: 幾位立法委員投票支持新的交通規則。

examples.en: My aunt wrote a letter to her local lawmaker.
examples.zh: 我阿姨寫了一封信給當地的立法委員。

examples.en: The company faced a lawsuit over its broken products.
examples.zh: 這家公司因為產品瑕疵而面臨訴訟。

examples.en: She decided to file a lawsuit against her landlord.
examples.zh: 她決定對房東提起訴訟。

examples.en: The lawsuit lasted for almost three years.
examples.zh: 這場官司持續了將近三年。

examples.en: My grandfather left us a small house as his legacy.
examples.zh: 我祖父留給我們一棟小房子當作遺產。

examples.en: The old mayor's legacy is a beautiful park in the city center.
examples.zh: 那位老市長留下的成就是市中心一座美麗的公園。

examples.en: Traditional music is an important part of our cultural legacy.
examples.zh: 傳統音樂是我們文化傳承的重要一部分。

examples.en: New legislation will protect workers from unfair treatment.
examples.zh: 新的法規將保護勞工免於不公平的對待。

examples.en: The government is working on legislation about online safety.
examples.zh: 政府正在制定有關網路安全的法規。

examples.en: Lawmakers spent months debating the health legislation.
examples.zh: 立法委員花了好幾個月討論這項健康法案。

examples.en: The legislative process can take many months.
examples.zh: 立法的過程可能需要好幾個月。

examples.en: She works as an assistant in the legislative office.
examples.zh: 她在立法委員辦公室擔任助理。

examples.en: The legislative branch makes the laws of a country.
examples.zh: 立法機關負責制定國家的法律。

senses.zh: 合法的；正當的；真實可信的

examples.en: This is a legitimate business with all the proper licenses.
examples.zh: 這是一家擁有所有合格執照的合法企業。

examples.en: You have a legitimate reason to ask for a refund.
examples.zh: 你有正當的理由要求退費。

examples.en: Please make sure the website is legitimate before you pay.
examples.zh: 付款前請確認這個網站是真實可信的。

examples.en: Write it down lest you forget the address.
examples.zh: 把它寫下來，以免你忘記地址。

examples.en: She spoke softly lest she wake the baby.
examples.zh: 她輕聲說話，唯恐吵醒寶寶。

examples.en: Take an umbrella lest you get wet on the way home.
examples.zh: 帶把傘，以免回家途中淋濕。

examples.en: The company accepted full liability for the accident.
examples.zh: 公司對這起意外承擔全部責任。

examples.en: Large debts can become a serious liability for a small shop.
examples.zh: 龐大的債務可能成為小店的沉重負擔。

examples.en: The accountant listed all the company's liabilities in the annual report.
examples.zh: 會計師在年度報告中列出了公司的所有負債。

examples.en: There is a high likelihood of rain this afternoon.
examples.zh: 今天下午下雨的可能性很高。

examples.en: The likelihood of winning the lottery is very small.
examples.zh: 中樂透的可能性非常小。

examples.en: Regular exercise reduces the likelihood of getting sick.
examples.zh: 規律運動能降低生病的可能性。

examples.en: My sister cleaned her room, and I did likewise.
examples.zh: 我姐姐整理了她的房間，我也一樣整理了。

examples.en: My neighbor wished me a pleasant weekend, and I replied, "Likewise!"
examples.zh: 鄰居祝我週末愉快，我回答：「你也是！」

examples.en: Watch how he does it, and then do likewise.
examples.zh: 看他怎麼做，然後照著做。

examples.en: Students often relax in the lounge between classes.
examples.zh: 學生常在課間到交誼廳休息。

examples.en: We waited in the airport lounge for our flight.
examples.zh: 我們在機場貴賓室等候班機。

examples.en: The hotel has a quiet lounge on the first floor.
examples.zh: 這間飯店一樓有一間安靜的休息室。

examples.en: He likes to lounge on the sofa on Sunday mornings.
examples.zh: 他喜歡在週日早晨懶洋洋地靠在沙發上。

examples.en: The cat lounged in the sun by the window.
examples.zh: 貓咪在窗邊的陽光下懶洋洋地躺著。

examples.en: We lounged by the pool all afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們整個下午都在泳池邊閒坐。

examples.en: She put a lump of sugar in her tea.
examples.zh: 她在茶裡放了一塊方糖。

examples.en: The doctor checked the lump on his neck.
examples.zh: 醫師檢查了他脖子上的腫塊。

examples.en: There was a lump of clay on the table.
examples.zh: 桌上有一塊黏土。

examples.en: This kind of music is slowly moving into the mainstream.
examples.zh: 這類音樂正慢慢進入主流。

examples.en: Her ideas are outside the mainstream of modern education.
examples.zh: 她的想法不屬於現代教育的主流。

examples.en: The band left the mainstream to make its own music.
examples.zh: 這個樂團脫離主流，創作自己的音樂。

examples.en: Mainstream media often reports the same stories.
examples.zh: 主流媒體常報導相同的新聞。

examples.en: Electric cars are becoming more mainstream every year.
examples.zh: 電動車逐年變得更主流。

examples.en: He prefers mainstream movies to art films.
examples.zh: 比起藝術電影，他比較喜歡主流電影。

examples.en: The elevator is closed for maintenance this week.
examples.zh: 電梯這週因維修而停用。

examples.en: Regular maintenance keeps your bike in good condition.
examples.zh: 定期保養能讓你的腳踏車維持良好狀態。

examples.en: The school hired a team for building maintenance.
examples.zh: 學校聘請了一個團隊負責大樓維護。

examples.en: A whale is a mammal, not a fish.
examples.zh: 鯨魚是哺乳動物，不是魚。

examples.en: Most mammals feed their babies with milk.
examples.zh: 大多數哺乳動物用乳汁餵養幼獸。

examples.en: The science class studied small mammals in the forest.
examples.zh: 自然課研究了森林裡的小型哺乳動物。

examples.en: The mayor won the election with a clear mandate.
examples.zh: 市長以明確的民意授權贏得選舉。

examples.en: The committee's mandate is to improve school safety.
examples.zh: 委員會的任務是改善校園安全。

examples.en: The new mandate requires everyone to wear a helmet.
examples.zh: 新的規定要求每個人都要戴安全帽。

examples.en: The law mandates seat belts for all passengers.
examples.zh: 法律強制規定所有乘客都要繫安全帶。

examples.en: The school mandated an early start time for exams.
examples.zh: 學校規定考試必須提早開始。

examples.en: Voters mandated the city to build more parks.
examples.zh: 選民授權市政府興建更多公園。

examples.en: It was manifest that she had not slept well.
examples.zh: 很明顯她沒有睡好。

examples.en: His manifest honesty won the trust of everyone.
examples.zh: 他的誠實有目共睹，贏得了大家的信任。

examples.en: The manifest error in the report surprised the manager.
examples.zh: 報告中顯而易見的錯誤讓經理很驚訝。

examples.en: Her fear manifested itself as a quiet voice.
examples.zh: 她的恐懼表現在說話聲音很小。

examples.en: The disease may manifest in different ways.
examples.zh: 這種疾病可能以不同方式顯現。

examples.en: His kindness manifested in many small acts of help.
examples.zh: 他的善良表現在許多小小的幫忙舉動上。

examples.en: Some ads try to manipulate how people feel.
examples.zh: 有些廣告試圖操控人們的情緒。

examples.en: The machine can manipulate heavy objects with ease.
examples.zh: 這部機器能輕鬆搬動沉重的物體。
